news.title: 继大规模裁员之后，Bungie确认计划转租其位于贝尔维尤的巨型总部的部分区域

others.title: Bungie 确认计划在大规模裁员后转租其庞大的贝尔维尤总部的部分区域

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/PQOqpebubxdAxcx.jpg
Bungie 确认正在“探索转租方案”，涉及其位于华盛顿州贝尔维尤（Bellevue）庞大总部中的 210,984 平方英尺空间。该公司表示，此举反映了其对“数字优先”模式的持续关注。
继 6 月份 Bungie 团队大规模裁员后，该工作室决定将贝尔维尤总部的大部分空间对外转租，这意味着它将把部分空间出租给第三方。
据报道，在查阅了一份商业租赁手册中该建筑的 10 页广告后，消息被曝光。广告称该建筑有 210,984 平方英尺的空间可供转租，租期至 2035 年 9 月 30 日。如此长的时间跨度让粉丝们对 Bungie 未来的项目感到担忧。
Bungie 在一份声明中确认了这一消息，称此举反映了公司对远程办公日益增长的关注，这与其“数字优先”模式相契合。
“Bungie 正在探索转租其位于华盛顿州贝尔维尤园区的方案，”工作室发言人表示。“工作室在几年前就转型为数字优先模式，此举反映了团队不断变化的工作场所需求以及远程协作的成效。Bungie 将继续在贝尔维尤保留实体办公室。”
社区对此反应不一；有些人认为考虑到刚刚发生的大规模裁员，这种变化是合乎逻辑的，而另一些人则担心这可能对 Bungie 的未来意味着什么。
“我看到有人对此感到悲观，但在目前的情况下，这难道不是很有道理吗？”一位用户在 X 上写道。“400 多人无法充分利用那么大的空间，转租总比让它落灰要好。”
“在我看来，Bungie 非常擅长制作游戏，我希望他们能填满所有这些空间，同时进行 2 到 5 个项目，”另一位用户表示。“但以他们现在的规模，这可能是明智的决定。”
“通俗地说，就是‘既然我们再也负担不起庞大的办公室了，现在我们要全部在家工作了，’”另一位评论道。
值得注意的是，Bungie 今年 6 月在其贝尔维尤办公室裁减了 292 名员工，这是三年内的第三轮裁员。据报道，该地点在 2023 年曾拥有 1,000 名员工；据称该公司在 2023 年 10 月至 2024 年 7 月期间裁员约 320 人，使得最近一轮裁员更显残酷。
这一最新消息发布之际，Bungie 的粉丝群正日益不满。在 9 月份的 PlayStation State of Play 直播期间，大量玩家在聊天栏刷屏要求推出 宿星的女朋友3 ―destiny star girlfriend―，此前开发者在今年早些时候结束了对该作的支持，转而专注于 马拉松The Messenger from Athens at Marathon。
消息人士告诉《福布斯》，曾有计划将游戏以 Destiny Infinity 的名义“重新发布”，但最终被废弃。据报道，Bungie 也考虑过 宿星的女朋友3 ―destiny star girlfriend―，但“事情并没有朝着那个方向发展”。

news.title: Rockstar 对中国版 GTA6: Extended Look 预告片进行删减处理

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/tdNDLXbubxdAvva.jpg
Rockstar Games 为中国发布了一个经过严格审查的 GTA6 深度展示版本。
GTA6
动作冒险, 角色扮演
PC 玩家们，我知道你们很急，但你们先 别 急。
查看更多 立即下载
正如 X/Twitter 用户 @videotech 所分享的，这家正在让发行商纷纷避开 11 月档期的工作室，上周在社交平台 Bilibili 上发布了长达 27 分钟的实机演示——但部分内容与其他地区的版本有所不同。很快就能发现，GTA6 预告片的大部分内容都被模糊处理了，包括舞蹈、违禁品相关内容以及成人内容。
考虑到这是一款 Grand Theft Auto V 传承版 游戏，被遮挡的内容相当多。例如，主角 Jason 和 Lucia 在夜总会的镜头几乎让屏幕变成了一片巨大的紫色模糊。随后的一个场景模糊了 Jason 抽烟时的手部，而海滩的简短镜头则对部分人群进行了打码。虽然大多数尸体似乎没有被模糊，但显示血腥尸体特写的镜头也被完全遮盖了。
这是一个视角非常独特的 GTA6 视频，但该视频最初并非如此模糊。正如 GTAForums 用户 BDF 所观察到的，据报道这与 Rockstar 在 GTA6: Extended Look 于 Netflix 首映后最初上传的视频并不相同。
据称，第一次上传的版本并没有像现在这样进行审查。据悉 Rockstar 在 8 月 31 日左右修改了视频。目前尚不清楚延迟调整背后的原因。
BDF 指出，这些改动在贴吧以及其他在线社区中引起了玩家的分歧。虽然一些人怀疑 Rockstar 审查 GTA6 是为了防止未成年用户看到预告片内容，但其他人认为此举反映了 Rockstar 及其母公司 Take-Two Interactive 的某种偏见。BDF 还报告称，Rockstar 和 Take-Two 已对在 Bilibili 上重新发布未打码内容的用户发出了 DMCA 版权警告。
无论是否经过审查，GTA6 的宣传攻势已正式开启，该作将于 11 月 19 日登陆 PlayStation 5 和 Xbox Series X | S。就在昨天，全新的罪恶都市主题 PS5 手柄正式公布，本周早些时候 Rockstar 官网也发布了更多截图，玩家们仍在挖掘上周大规模实机演示中的每一个细节。
在正式发售之前，肯定还会有更多内容展示。

news.title: Team Heretics 发布 Koshmaras

content.v: Team Heretics 已正式与决斗位选手 Martynas "koshmaras" Namikas 解约，结束了双方不到五个月的合作关系。
此次变动目前仍在等待 Riot 的最终审批，据信双方已达成协议，以协商解约的方式终止合同。此前 koshmaras 与 Team Heretics 的合同原定持续至 2028 赛季。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/CWbFVTbubxcdxci.jpg
koshmaras 准备举起 EMEA 第一赛段奖杯。（图片来源：Wojciech Wandzel/Riot Games）。
本周早些时候，Team Heretics 的指挥 (IGL) Boo 也被获准接触其他队伍，其合同将于本休赛期到期。
“这是一次非常美妙的经历，向我的队友和工作人员致以诚挚的谢意，我们已经成为了终身的朋友，”koshmaras 表示，“对于那些信任我并给予支持的粉丝们，非常感谢！”
koshmaras 加入 Team Heretics 的过程广为人知，当时战队在第一赛段中途决定更换选手 ComeBack，并对此过程保持了高度透明。在加入 Team Heretics 之前，他仅代表 DNSTY 出战了两场比赛。此前，他还曾效力于 DNSTY、Agent X、6GPA、LEO Esports、Vultures 和 AboveClouds 等队伍。

在 Team Heretics 效力期间，koshmaras 作为主力 Neon 玩家发挥了核心作用，帮助队伍在第一赛段夺冠。这次夺冠助力队伍成功晋级 Masters London，尽管在季后赛首轮轮空的情况下，最终仅获得 7-8 名。在第二赛段，Team Heretics 尝试让 koshmaras 使用 Phoenix 和 Omen 等其他特工，但表现挣扎。最终，该队在 EMEA 赛区年度排名中位列 11-12 名，远低于获得 Champions Shanghai 参赛资格的积分门槛。

news.title: 宏碁可变形掌机/笔记本二合一原型机上手体验

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/QFLIAbbubxanewD.jpg
欧洲最大的科技展 IFA 目前正在德国柏林举行，宏碁（Acer）决定展示其 "Project DualPlay Mini" 的两款工作原型机。
这款游戏掌机乍看之下相当普通，除了其极具攻击性的、符合品牌调性的掠夺者（Predator）风格设计外，但只要快速掀起前面的游戏面板并轻轻翻转屏幕，它就会变成一台性能尚可的迷你 PC。
在我大肆宣传之后，必须提到这只是一个原型机，这一点非常重要。这并不是你短期内能买到的东西，甚至可能永远买不到。宏碁告诉我，他们基本上是在试探市场，看看是否有足够的兴趣。虽然这纯粹是个人观点，但对我个人的非正式调查结果是：“是的，拜托，我的生活需要这台设备。”
对于一个没有明确发布计划的原型机来说，Project DualPlay Mini 的功能出奇地齐全。我试玩了 Forza Horizon 6，画面看起来棒极了，而且我很惊讶它内置了震动功能。如果说震动功能有什么预发布阶段的瑕疵，那就是它的声音出奇地大。但除此之外，它运行得非常好，为原本就很酷的体验增添了额外的维度。
极限竞速：地平线 6
竞速, 模拟, 体育
被骂的，恰恰是它最强的地方
查看更多 立即下载
我觉得掏出其中一台设备的感觉，就像在 2006 年左右掏出 T-Mobile Sidekick 一样拉风。
按钮和摇杆的感觉也很棒，触觉反馈出色，拇指摇杆体验极其流畅。屏幕看起来很惊艳，尽管宏碁的代表没有向我透露太多规格信息，因为展示的设备仍处于原型阶段。
从游戏模式转为迷你笔记本模式确实很有趣。你只需打开顶部并轻轻翻转屏幕即可进入笔记本模式。这里的一个大遗憾是没有触控板，但原型机确实有触摸屏，我在 Windows 11 桌面和 Steam 应用中导航没有任何问题。
老实说，当我第一次把它打开到笔记本模式时，我感受到了浓厚的 2011 年风格的上网本（Netbook）气息，我是带着爱意这么说的。那些小巧的上网本现在已经足够古老，能够唤起对那个怪异时代的怀旧之情——当时智能手机还不够智能，而普通笔记本电脑仍然太笨重。我觉得键盘用起来很愉快，就笔记本键盘而言，虽然它被定位为可转换的游戏掌机，但 WASD 和方向键在键帽上都有突出显示。
如果它真的成为现实，这可能是掌上设备使用键鼠操作的最佳方式。老实说，在短暂的体验之后，我非常希望它是真的。它是两个世界的结合，我觉得在火车或飞机上掏出这台设备，会像 2006 年左右掏出 T-Mobile Sidekick 一样拉风。
请宏碁把它变成现实吧。

news.title: DLSS 5 最终仍将支持老款显卡

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/cQcmVbbubwCFdxw.png
Nvidia 的 DLSS 5 神经渲染技术昨日在 NBA 2K27 中正式亮相，目前仅支持当前世代的 RTX 5000 系列显卡。但这种情况似乎会随时间推移而改变。
NBA 2K27
NBA, 篮球, 动作
查看更多 立即下载
在 Nvidia 论坛上，一名员工声称公司将在未来某个时间点将 DLSS 5 的支持范围扩大到 RTX 40 系列显卡，但我们可能需要等待一段时间。他表示：“我们目前的重点是优化 GeForce RTX 50 系列的性能，预计今年秋季晚些时候会发布模型更新，”但他同时指出，“一旦 RTX 50 系列的性能得到更充分的调优，我们计划着手将官方支持扩展到 GeForce RTX 40 系列。”

因此，至少就目前而言，该公司的重点似乎是让这项技术在当前世代显卡上运行得更流畅，然后再将其适配到 Ada Lovelace 架构。这也很合理。我简短地在 NBA 2K27 中试用了这项技术，令我惊讶的是，这些变化非常细微，至少与我在 Reddit 上看到的一些糟糕案例相比是这样。不过，尽管这项技术确实让 NBA 2K27 的画面看起来更好了，但它对性能产生了巨大影响，而我还是在 RTX 5090 上进行的测试。
在我的主系统上开启 DLSS 5 后，开启帧生成前的帧率从 57-60 fps 左右下降到了 37 fps 左右，性能降幅高达 43%。如果这是市场上最强显卡的性能损失，我对于像 RTX 4080 这样的显卡能处理得如何并不乐观，尤其是考虑到它搭载的是较旧的 Tensor Core。
不过显而易见的是，自今年 3 月首次公布以来，Nvidia 在优化该技术方面已经取得了很大进展。当时，Nvidia 甚至需要两张 RTX 5090 才能运行它，而现在“绿厂”声称已将模型性能提升了约 5 倍。随着进一步的优化，性能损失有可能随时间推移而减小。但在亲眼见到之前，我仍将保持怀疑态度。

news.title: 《生化危机4：重制版》新先导预告片发布，酷似 Las Plagas 的生物首次亮相

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/WWSGxJbubwCEDsm.jpg
Zach Cregger 执导的 生化危机4：重制版 电影发布了全新的西班牙语先导预告片，其中包含从未公开的触手状变异镜头，看起来与 生化危机4：重制版 4 中的寄生虫（Las Plagas）惊人地相似。
生化危机4：重制版
动作, 恐怖, 生存恐怖, 第三人称射击, 僵尸
《生化危机4：重制版》很好地传达出了原作的神髓，与2、3代重制版不得不取消静态摄像视角相比，4代的原版将这个系列直接带到了新派游戏的起点上，因此相对应的，重制版需要更改的内容更少，但是它知道怎样将游戏打磨得更加现代化，它知道在哪里施加压力，什么时候让你呼吸，完美地平衡了生存、战斗和解谜，也完美地平衡了恐惧、兴奋和满足。现在我们只有一个问题：《生化危机5》，卡普空想好怎么重制了吗？
查看更多 立即下载
这部于 2026 年 9 月 4 日发布的预告片中，由 Austin Abrams 饰演的 Bryan Hodukavich 小心地走进医院的产科病房，那里似乎已被某种血肉物质占领——不幸的是，原本安放新生儿的婴儿摇篮也没能幸免。
预告片的另一个镜头显示，一具尸体的脚正被细长的蠕虫状藤蔓吞噬。下一秒，这具尸体站了起来，似乎是由从其脸颊伸出的一根藤蔓所驱动，而一旁的 Hodukavich 则惊恐地注视着这一切。
毋庸置疑，这已经引发了人们将其与 Las Plagas 进行比较——这是 RE4 中导致光明教团（Los Illuminados）事件的寄生虫。这种特殊的变异以触手状生长物著称，随着生长阶段的推进，它们会转化为恐怖的生物。
Cregger 一直坦诚地表达了他对这部 生化危机4：重制版 电影的灵感来源，称 RE4 和 RE7 对他的创作手法影响最大。“我喜欢借鉴 生化危机4：重制版 4 的节奏和规模，并加入一些 生化危机4：重制版 7 的角色元素，”他在 9 月 1 日的 Reddit 问答中表示。
“RE7 是伊森登场的时候，我喜欢这种普通人陷入恐怖境地的设定。而 RE4 拥有我非常喜欢的节奏，让你在不同的场景和地点之间穿梭。RE4 是一款宏大的游戏，你会经历所有这些不同的地方——感觉就像不同的世界，从村庄到城堡，再到海岛。它总能不断带给玩家惊喜。”
这并不是 Cregger 的 生化危机4：重制版 电影今天唯一的精彩曝光；该电影的官方社交媒体账号还分享了一张宣传海报，展示了一只杜宾犬的 X 光影像——这种犬类在早期的几部作品中是令玩家头疼的经典敌人。帖子配文写道：“实验对象正在……发生变化”，暗示这只杜宾犬已经感染了 T 病毒。
这是一个对早期 生化危机4：重制版 游戏的极佳致敬，也是 Cregger 在其对该系列的诠释中加入的又一个彩蛋，此外还有大量其他参考元素将其愿景与原作素材联系在一起。
Cregger 的电影讲述了一个全新的故事，跟随一个被卷入浣熊市事件疯狂漩涡的普通人。虽然他坚决反对 1:1 还原游戏以避免重复“那些已经被讲述得很好的故事”，但 Cregger 也理解为什么粉丝可能会犹豫是否要给他一个机会，他在一次专访中表示，认为粉丝会支持他避开直接改编游戏的想法是“天真”的。

news.title: 在街机热门游戏《Railbreak DX》中获取高分，现已登陆 XBOX Series X|S 及 XPA

content.v: 总结
你好！欢迎来到你人生中最刺激的街机体验！我是 Julia Wolbach，非常激动能向大家介绍《Railbreak DX》。这款画面极其硬核的轨道射击游戏今日正式登陆 Xbox Series X|S 平台，并支持 Xbox Play Anywhere（XPA）以及 Xbox 云游戏。请继续阅读，获取开发者秘籍，提升你的丧尸射击技巧。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/WRltDNbubwBsfxs.jpg
故事模式中的诸多谜团
在《Railbreak DX》的主线故事中，你将扮演坚韧的侦探 Lydia Daniels 或性格古怪的雇佣兵 Hank。在这场丧尸大爆发的 Cypress Ridge 惊险冒险中，你会发现城市中散落着各种有用的补给品和可破坏的物体。这也是唯一一个可以在环境中捡起特殊武器来改变游戏玩法的模式。Lydia 绝对是一位神枪手！
由于游戏的镜头控制是自动的，你需要密切关注并保持敏锐的反应，以发现每个关卡中隐藏的强力武器。虽然你总是随身携带可靠的手枪，但在第四幕中，只要你眼疾手快，就能发现该武器的变体。当你在公园散步时，留意长椅上是否有马格南手枪，它的伤害力大幅提升。故事模式中还有更多“机密”杀伤性武器等待发掘：有传言说你甚至能找到一把注入等离子能量的冲锋枪！
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/GSqCUhbubwBshic.jpg
各具特色的角色与游戏风格
除了有趣的故事模式，还有许多可选的幸存者等待解锁，每个人都有自己的装备、射击速度、伤害率和其他特性。在最初的《Railbreak》中，有 9 名可控角色，而在《Railbreak DX》中，共有 18 位个性鲜明的角色供你选择，挑战最高分数。
角色优劣势分析
如果你觉得生存最重要，那么选择 Michael 是个不错的方案。敌人无法对他造成“中毒”或“流血”效果，因此你无需寻找蓝色和红色芽孢来治愈这些磨人的负面状态。但作为代价，你的主武器是一把非常消耗弹药的霰弹枪。虽然你永远不用担心备用手枪子弹耗尽，但霰弹枪的低效在更高难度下可能会让你陷入险境。

相反，选择 Rin 可以提升你的得分潜力，但同时也伴随着早夭的风险。她的特制手枪有一定几率用冰弹冻结丧尸，但如果不能命中头部，她所造成的伤害会大打折扣。在这里，准确度比以往任何时候都重要！Rin 还配备了一把武士刀，而且它绝非凡品。如果你用刀气击中敌人，会激活一种特殊状态，在短时间内获得高分并造成更高伤害，但副作用是会同时触发一个随机的负面状态。使用 Rin 的操作难度很高，尤其是她甚至无法通过肢解丧尸来平衡战场优势！
更多战斗技巧
还在寻找更多情报吗？以下是一些助你征服《Railbreak DX》的实用技巧！虽然城市陷入了混乱，但这绝不是你对无辜平民开火的借口！伤害无辜平民会受到严厉惩罚；如果你误伤平民，你自己的生命值也会扣除！不过别担心：如果你投掷手榴弹清场或引爆特殊的感染生物，即使 Cypress Ridge 的居民被波及，你也不会受到惩罚。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/ySasUhbubwBsjvh.jpg
如何最大化手榴弹的价值

虽然手榴弹在危急时刻很有用，但它们提供的分数微乎其微。只有在万不得已时才考虑使用。提升分数的最佳方法是瞄准敌人的四肢和头部。精准的爆头会获得额外的伤害和分数加成。对大多数普通丧尸来说，攻击四肢可以将其完全断开，从而限制它们的攻击和移动。如果敌人连挥动手臂的肢体都没有了，你就不会被打到！最后，当你遇到像“Boom Boom”或“Kunoichi”这样的怪物时，优先击败它们以引发清场爆炸。谁不喜欢更多的混乱呢？
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/DOVyAdbubwBslkb.jpg
豪华版内容的丰富体验
关于《Railbreak DX》有太多值得聊的内容，比如将恐龙加入战斗的选项、无穷无尽的“Onslaught”挑战模式，以及让你的探索陷入混乱的不可预测的“Glitch”效果。此外，你可以利用 Xbox 云游戏功能，无需下载即可在线游玩《Railbreak DX》；或者通过 Xbox Play Anywhere 功能在 PC 或掌机上继续你的冒险，确保你的进度和成就无论在哪游玩都能同步。
立即购买《Railbreak DX》，体验融合了现代画质与新玩法的经典街机动作快感。请持续关注未来的内容更新和付费 DLC，这些内容定会进一步丰富这场荒诞而有趣的冒险。下次再见，千万别因为弹匣打空而陷入困境！
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/XikbubbubwBsnde.jpg
Railbreak DX
Dead Drop Studios LLC
注意： 请注意，原版旧作《Railbreak》将于 2026 年 9 月从个人直接销售渠道下架。《Railbreak DX》旨在作为一款长期支持的扩展体验，提供全新的画质、打磨、玩法以及更多内容。与旧作不同，《Railbreak DX》全面支持 Xbox Play Anywhere。
Cypress Ridge 街机厅中最令人兴奋的游戏迎来了大升级！选择你的幸存者，在燃烧的城市中杀出一条血路。这款轨道生存恐怖射击游戏现已通过新功能和更好的视觉效果进行了强化。哦，别忘了叫上朋友一起当丧尸饲料——我是说，一起体验多人模式！
《Railbreak DX》将经典的轨道街机体验与尖端的虚幻引擎 5 结合。作为《Outbreak: Shades of Horror》的前传，你将有机会领略 Cypress Ridge 的风景，并被丧尸啃咬！你可以独自面对这座城市，也可以通过全程支持的可选 2 人合作模式邀请好友加入。
游戏拥有丰富的幸存者阵容，每位角色都有自己的装备和特性，在这款生存恐怖游戏中的“生存恐怖游戏”里，你将发现极高的重玩价值。六个剧本构成了完整的故事模式体验。奖励模式包括“得分攻击（Score Attack）”、难度不断攀升直至被丧尸淹没的无尽“Onslaught”模式，以及充满变数的 Roguelike 体验“Glitch Gauntlet”。
《Railbreak DX》新增了九个可玩角色、独特的武器、全面的游戏平衡性调整、练习模式以及重大的画质升级！此外，你还可以选择面对经典的丧尸、来自《DINOBREAK》的恐怖恐龙，或者将两者混合在一起，重新定义你的战斗体验！
检查一下沙发垫里有没有硬币，拿上一瓶汽水，带你回到 1990 年代的街机厅。

游戏特性： – 九个全新可玩角色，以及对所有角色的全面重制和平衡，包括不同的武器、弹匣容量、射击频率等。 – 可破坏的环境，让你发现新的物品和武器以在围攻中生存。 – 经典丧尸与《DINOBREAK》中的恐龙联手，你可以选择只对抗丧尸、只对抗恐龙，或将两种敌人混合在一起。 – 完整的练习模式，允许你使用无限生命且无障碍地尝试新角色。 – 大幅改进的玩家和敌人动画，包括完全动画化的武器模型。 – 由虚幻引擎 5 驱动的次世代街机体验，支持光线追踪等最新技术。 – 多种挑战丧尸的方式：故事模式、得分攻击、无尽的 Onslaught 模式、Roguelike 的 Glitch Gauntlet 等。 – 强烈的血腥表现和肢解系统，让你用强大的武器库撕碎丧尸。 – 轨道射击游戏中出现过的最“烂”的台词和配音。 – 全程可选 2 人合作模式。

news.title: 神谷英树告诉 Xbox CEO：只要她准备好，他已准备好制作 龙鳞化身

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/NTJbTbbubwzrego.png
猎天使魔女3 创作者神谷英树向 Xbox 首席执行官 Asha Sharma 传达了一个信息：当她准备好制作 龙鳞化身 时，他会一直等待。
龙鳞化身
动作, 冒险
查看更多 立即下载
这位动作游戏大师及 Clovers 工作室负责人在最近接受采访时，表达了希望回归这一被取消的巨龙 IP 的愿望。自白金工作室在 2014 年公布 龙鳞化身 以来，微软最终正式确认取消该项目已过去九年多。尽管如此，神谷英树表示他随时准备为该作注入新的生命。
当被问及是否已就 龙鳞化身 联系过 Sharma 时，他表示：“目前还没有，但现在是我再次表态的机会，如果他们想做，那就让我们实现它吧！”
“[Clovers 总裁小山健人] 也表示赞同，”他补充道。神谷英树随后请求展示一些向公众发布的少量 龙鳞化身 素材，以便让 Sharma 看看。
神谷英树及白金工作室的其他成员于 12 年前的 E3 2014 上公布了这款现已取消的 Xbox One 独占动作角色扮演游戏。从那时起，情况发生了很大变化。
一年后，龙鳞化身 曾在 2015 年的 Gamescom 上再次亮相，但随后便归于沉寂。宣布延期至 2017 年引发了人们对该项目可能陷入困境的担忧，随后的报道也暗示了危机，直到微软最终下达了“死刑”。
尽管神谷英树已不在白金工作室任职，但他确认自己在 2024 年底参与组建了 Clovers 工作室。虽然该团队目前正埋头开发 猫神公司：人类复原计划 Nekokami 2，但这并不意味着他不希望有朝一日能回归 龙鳞化身。多年来，他和其他白金工作室的开发人员曾多次表达过对重启该项目的兴趣。现在，他希望 Sharma 能协助促成此事。
在接受采访时，神谷英树回忆了最近与 龙鳞化身 团队部分成员的聚餐。他提到，这款被取消的游戏并非他们讨论的唯一话题，但“确实被提及了几次”，并且大家“都记得开发过程是多么有趣”。
“显然，当时也经历过一些艰难时刻，但作为项目总监，看到大家如今回首往事仍觉得充满乐趣，我感到非常欣慰，”神谷英树解释道。“当然，项目最终未能问世非常令人遗憾，即便到了现在，我依然非常强烈地渴望如果可能的话能完成它，我说这话是百分之百认真的。”
神谷英树表示，Clovers “目前可能还没有能力”立即着手 龙鳞化身 的开发，但这仍是他正在追求的目标。他甚至表示：“我坚信，如果你足够强烈地想要某样东西，你最终会找到实现它的方法。”
“目前的 猫神公司：人类复原计划 Nekokami 就是如此，”他继续说道，“即使在这么多年后，机会再次出现，我希望未来的 龙鳞化身 也能如此。”

与神谷英树一样，Xbox 最近也经历了自己的变革。Sharma 于今年 2 月接替 Phil Spencer 担任首席执行官，主导了微软游戏部门的一系列快速变革，粉丝对此褒贬不一。例如，该公司上周宣布将允许玩家将实体版游戏数字化。这一举措尤其受到粉丝好评，但对于 Xbox 在 7 月宣布裁员 3200 人并放弃 Double Fine 和 Ninja Theory 等工作室所带来的冲击，几乎没有起到缓冲作用。
Sharma 和 Xbox 的其他成员是否有空间促成 龙鳞化身 仍有待观察。在等待未来进展的同时，你可以回顾神谷英树在 2021 年对该游戏的评价。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/wSugyHbubwwejsj.jpg
权力的游戏凛冬将至：疯王（The Mad King）将于明年登陆伦敦。
权力的游戏凛冬将至
策略, 角色扮演, 大型多人在线
查看更多 立即下载
作者乔治·R·R·马丁透露，皇家莎士比亚剧团将于 2027 年将这部前传舞台剧带到英国首都。目前尚未公布具体场馆或首映日期。
“我在斯特拉特福德观看邓肯·麦克米伦和多米尼克·库克执导的史诗级新舞台剧 权力的游戏凛冬将至：疯王时度过了一段美好的时光。此外，我很高兴地宣布，该制作将移师伦敦，与更广泛的观众分享这一体验，”马丁在博客中写道。
权力的游戏凛冬将至：疯王于 7 月在斯特拉特福德的皇家莎士比亚剧院开始了为期六周的演出。该剧将于本周结束放映，目前已收获如潮好评，且多场演出门票售罄。
该剧的背景设定在马丁的第一部《冰与火之歌》小说开始前约 15 年。它记录了国王伊里斯·坦格利安二世（又名“疯王”）的陨落，他在篡夺者战争期间被推翻。
有相关报道解析了该剧揭示的关于维斯特洛大陆的 9 件事，这些都是 权力的游戏凛冬将至 粉丝想要了解的内容，包括雷加·坦格利安如何在历史上深受冤屈，以及丹妮莉丝和琼恩·雪诺是在同一晚受孕的。
欲了解更多关于维斯特洛的信息，可以查看为什么《伊耿征服》电影应该借鉴《沙丘》三部曲的策略，并阅读关于以 House of the Dragon 中的叙拉克斯（Syrax）命名的新蜥蜴物种的相关报道。此外，请务必预订 House of the Dragon Season 3 的 4K 钢盒版。

news.title: 《战争机器：事变日》战役——绝望世界中的兄弟情谊与希望 | Xbox官方播客

content.v: 在本期《官方 Xbox 播客》中，我们来到了科隆游戏展（gamescom），并与《战争机器：事变日》背后的开发团队进行了深度对话！我们深入探讨了最近发布的剧情预告片，聊到了《战争机器：事变日》故事中蕴含的希望与兄弟情谊，并亲手体验了为该游戏打造的定制手柄。
战争机器：事变日
射击
查看更多 立即下载
访谈录音
嘉宾：
Jeff Rubenstein ：欢迎收听《官方 Xbox 播客》，这是唯一一档从 Xbox 内部——或者说从 Xbox 展台内部为您带来的节目。我们现在身处科隆游戏展，很高兴能邀请到 The Coalition 工作室的成员，他们正在向大家展示《战争机器：事变日》。Matt Searcy，感谢你今天加入我们；还有战役设计总监 Raul Figueroa，欢迎你首次做客我们的节目。
Matt Searcy ：关于《齿轮与湮灭（Gears of Annihilation）》系列，很多人会提到它的“残酷”，但在我看来，这次《战争机器：事变日》几乎树立了一个新的标准。这种残酷感有时带有恐怖片的色彩。在制作预告片时，我们想尽力展现游戏的精髓，没有什么比以最残酷的方式介绍我们全新的大反派 Vraahk 更好的开场了。
Raul Figueroa ：Vraahk 是一位灾兽指挥官（Blight Commander），他在“兰顿战争”（Lambent War）中受过伤。他来到地表的目标就是消灭人类，这就是为什么我们把他设计得如此残暴。我们想传达出他们就是要彻底铲除人类的意图。
Matt Searcy ：他本质上体现了兽族（Locust）的残暴。预告片中另一个酷点在于，你可以看到他身边的精英部队“焦灼军团”（Scorched Legion），他们身上长着尖刺，这种自残行为也体现了同样的残酷。在游戏中，即使你不直接面对 Vraahk，当你面对他的精英部队时，你也能感受到那种残暴的氛围。
谈到剧情，这不仅仅是“Bravo 小队”的故事，你还会与城中许多其他士兵擦肩而过。他们每个人都有自己的历史。《战争机器：事变日》的精妙之处在于，你身处一个更大的兄弟会之中，共同面对这种不可能战胜的威胁。
Raul Figueroa ：我们投入了大量精力来营造那种并肩作战的兄弟情谊，大家都在互相帮助，试图理解究竟发生了什么。这是一个全新的威胁，他们从未见过这样的敌人。
Jeff Rubenstein ：这似乎还有一丝希望的火花。人们在这一阶段还不清楚事态会有多糟糕。
Matt Searcy ：虽然我们知道结果是绝望的。将游戏设定在 Kalona 市，是为了在宏大的事件背景下进行一场非常私密的战斗。Sera 星球三分之二的人口被消灭，这确实是一场巨大的灾难。但通过聚焦于一座城市和这些人物，我们可以去探讨在最初的两天里，试图争取某种胜利、保持某种希望意味着什么。虽然游戏中充满了损失，但通过损失、兄弟情谊和忠诚这些主题来展现，对我们来说非常重要。
Jeff Rubenstein ：考虑到《齿轮与湮灭（Gears of Annihilation） 1》到《齿轮与湮灭（Gears of Annihilation） 5》的世界观中，世界早已被摧毁，你可能不会感受到那种“失去”的痛楚。但因为在这里你看到了世界原本的样子，看到了我们社会中熟悉的事物，那种悲剧感就变得更加深刻了。
Matt Searcy ：没错。在《战争机器：事变日》中，最酷的一点是每一个敌人的出现都是“第一次”。这是 Marcus 和 Dom 第一次见到他们，这也是人类第一次见到他们。从游戏中的第一只小怪到第一只无人机，再到披甲的 Brumak，你感受到的不仅仅是怪物袭击，而是一场来自地下的、压倒性的战争。这正是《战争机器：重装上阵》系列的精髓。
Jeff Rubenstein ：关于 Kalona 这座城市，你希望玩家从中获得什么体验？
Raul Figueroa ：从一开始，我们就希望 Kalona 成为一个能与玩家产生共鸣的“角色”。我们从零开始构建它，希望人们理解在这座城市生活是什么感觉。随着战役推进，看到城市分崩离析，人们在死去，而你尽力拯救你能拯救的人，这会产生巨大的冲击力。
Matt Searcy ：游戏整体是线性的，但在某些区域，我们会给你几个街区的活动空间。虽然任务在身，但路线由你决定。当你探索角落时，可能会遇到其他正在抵御兽族的小队，或者被困在建筑里的家庭。如果你决定帮助他们，会获得叙事上的奖励。此外，我们首次在战役中引入了武器改装系统。如果你愿意探索，会有海量的环境叙事和支线目标。
Jeff Rubenstein ：关于操作，玩家现在的灵活性更高了，比如有跳跃键。同时，我看到很多评论说兽族的智能也大幅提升了。这是否意味着你们在增强玩家能力的同时，也必须提升敌人的智商？
Raul Figueroa ：是的，绝对。我们的目标是让兽族看起来既危险又聪明。你通过爬上卡车来侧翼包抄？他们也会这样做。有时候你会惊讶地发现，一个榴弹兵跳到车顶，然后绕到你身后用霰弹枪近距离射击。这让你必须保持警惕，调整战术。
Matt Searcy ：这就是《齿轮与湮灭（Gears of Annihilation）》的魔法所在：掩体位置、武器组合以及敌人配置。当敌人有了更多战术时，游戏的挑战性就变得像解谜一样，你必须动脑思考，而不仅仅是简单的射击。
Jeff Rubenstein ：关于这次新公布的《齿轮与湮灭（Gears of Annihilation）: E-Day》定制手柄，能分享一下设计灵感吗？
Matt Searcy ：这款手柄有着蚀刻的“E-hole”（地洞）破碎感和混凝土纹理。透明的外壳下可以看到“Omen”（兽族标志）。我们还加入了橡胶握把，手感极佳。我们非常喜欢 Luke Preece 的艺术创作，通过 Xbox Design Lab，玩家可以将他的艺术风格与自己喜爱的颜色、按钮类型和纹理相结合。
Jeff Rubenstein ：最后，关于发售日，大家已经等不及了。
Matt Searcy ：游戏将于 10 月 6 日发售，抢先体验版在 10 月 1 日开启。距离现在仅剩一个月多一点，我们已经迫不及待让玩家亲自去体验了。
更多资讯 请务必关注 Xbox YouTube 频道，查看更多《战争机器：事变日》的相关内容。此外，我们也刚刚发布了《女神异闻录4：无敌究极后桥背摔》相关的播客节目，欢迎收听。感谢大家收看本期《官方 Xbox 播客》。

news.title: 《鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny)》展现了卡普空为何正处于连胜势头

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/wwghKcbubwsynaf.jpg

很少有发行商能像 Capcom 这样在过去十年中取得如此辉煌的成就。该公司销量最高的 10 款游戏全部是在过去 10 年内推出的，这一连串的好运始于 2017 年的 生化危机7 云版本。Capcom 对这款游戏界最重要的生存恐怖系列的重塑，成为了其更广泛成功的一种模式，而这种模板在今年的 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 中再次得到了体现。

除了几次复刻和衍生项目外，鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 已经沉寂了 20 年。整个最初的四部曲都是在 PS2 时代发布的，因此自 2006 年的最后一作 Dawn of Dreams 以来，游戏技术已经经历了近三个完整的机能世代更迭。那个项目引入了在 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 出现之前该系列最“现代”的想法：全 3D 摄像机视角。而在更早的作品中，鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 使用的是固定摄像机视角和预渲染背景，就像早期的 生化危机4：重制版 一样。

这其中有一个很好的理由：鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 基本上就是武士版的 生化危机4：重制版。2001 年的 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Warlords 主要设定在一座城堡内，是一款关于解谜、解锁大门和吃草药保命的游戏。生化危机4：重制版 的联合主创三上真司甚至为该项目提供了建议。随着每一部续作的推出，该系列逐渐摆脱了生存恐怖的血统，但对于 2020 年代的全新 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 来说，如果看到 Capcom 回归原点，本质上克隆其 生化危机4：重制版 2 remake，只是在其中填满武士和恶魔，也并不会令人感到意外。毕竟，生化危机7 云版本 的大部分成功都要归功于对过去的重塑，贝克农场就是斯宾塞洋馆的南方哥特式变体。

但 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 并不是带武士刀的 生化危机4：重制版。如果非要说的话，它是 Capcom 对索尼圣莫尼卡工作室现代 战神：诸神黄昏 系列的回应。它拥有激烈的近战格斗和一系列华丽的技能。你会面对巨大的 Boss，其中一些还会多次出现。宝藏隐藏在复杂的环境谜题之后。你的主角宫本武藏会侧身挤过缝隙，并由一位话太多的灵魂导师陪同。
战神：诸神黄昏
经典, 北欧神话, 奇幻, 动作冒险
抛开强行植入黑人女孩的争议，《战神：诸神黄昏》无疑是对得起玩家对它的期望的，站在前作的肩膀上，本作成功做到了推陈出新、稳中有进，带给了玩家非常优秀的游戏体验...
查看更多 立即下载

不过，这仍然是 Capcom 成功模式的体现，只是侧重点不同。生化危机7 云版本 的成功既在于对根源的重新关注，也在于广泛吸收影响。为了在过于浮夸的 RE6 之后让 生化危机4：重制版 回到正轨，Capcom 研究了恐怖游戏的现状。它看到了 Frictional Games 那部极其恐怖的 失忆症：黑暗后裔 的成功，以及第一人称视角带来的有限视野如何营造出压抑的氛围——这种方法将小岛秀夫 空匣子 Empty Box 中简单的走廊变成了循环的噩梦。结合公司在 90 年代完善的迷宫式关卡设计，这将成为理想的系列重启之作。于是 生化危机7 云版本 诞生了。Capcom 在这十年间的另一款里程碑式游戏中也可以看到类似的方法——通过采用在西方广受欢迎的开放世界格式，怪物猎人世界 将一个小众系列转变为 Capcom 最畅销的游戏，销量超过了 1000 万份。
鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 并不是带武士刀的 生化危机4：重制版。如果非要说的话，它是 Capcom 对现代 战神：诸神黄昏 系列的回应。

在 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 中，你可以看到 Capcom 如何研究 战神：诸神黄昏 和类似的现代动作冒险游戏的成功，从而为 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 寻找新的身份。这些学习成果不仅体现在关卡设计和个人功能上，还体现在基调上：鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 出奇地幽默。就像内森·德雷克一样，武藏在京都冒险时满口俏皮话。他的面部以传奇演员、黑泽明的合作伙伴三船敏郎为原型，表情极其丰富，通常是为了达到喜剧效果。

原作也很滑稽，但更多是因为那是当时游戏的写作方式——就像最初的 生化危机4：重制版 一样，鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Warlords 的剧本中有很多无意间的幽默。但是，就像现代的 生化危机4：重制版 时代一样，Capcom 做出了刻意的选择。在 生化危机4：重制版 中，它抛弃了滑稽感，加倍强化了恐怖感。重制版比原版更加阴暗，而 生化危机7 云版本 则拥有那种让你感到破伤风般的肮脏恐惧，RE8 召唤轮转 则在贝内文托府邸中包含了该系列最恐怖的惊吓。对于 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny)，Capcom 走向了另一个方向，将原作中那种类似《恐龙战队》式的滑稽感变成了一种刻意的风格。虽然许多人为了更“地道”的体验会选择日语配音，但我认为 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 英语配音中那种古怪的英伦腔是故意的——不仅让武藏更有趣，还将他的幻魔对手变成了京都版的伦敦口音兽人（一句“看来武士又回到菜单上了，伙计们！”放在这里会非常合适）。虽然 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 确实有相当多的黑暗和恐怖来反映原作的生存恐怖倾向，但这里有很多值得一笑的地方，而 Capcom 确实希望你笑出来。

但 Capcom 也希望你流汗，这就是 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 最大成就的体现。尽管原作很有趣，但 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 的剑斗从未提供过任何实质性的深度。如果要对得起它的新副标题，最新作绝对需要一种新的方法。它借鉴了 FromSoftware 的杰作 只狼：影逝二度，并聪明地在没有将 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 变成类魂游戏的情况下做到了这一点。
只狼：影逝二度
单人, 部分支持控制器, 动作冒险, 动作角色扮演, Souls-like
《只狼》作为宫崎英高对魂系列游戏的又一次成功探索，无疑将系列游戏的水平又拉高了一些。游戏的战斗帅气之余充满挑战，探索精妙地图迷人，暗藏玄机又富有东方韵味的剧情妙不可言，以电子游戏的角度来说，《只狼》堪称历史级别的卓越！
查看更多 立即下载

关于 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 有多“魂”，目前已经存在一些争论，在大多数情况下，答案是“一点也不”。但在涉及到 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 的 Boss 时，与 只狼：影逝二度 的相似性是不可否认的。招架是你最强大的武器，配合敌人刀刃的节奏模式是开启攻击窗口的主要方式。就像 只狼：影逝二度 一样，这是一款通过消耗敌人体力，然后在造成大量爆发伤害之前重置这场致命舞蹈的游戏。这需要进攻和防守之间的微妙平衡，因为给敌人空间会让他们恢复体力，而这正是你需要削减以施加最严厉惩罚的东西。你不能简单地通过狂按攻击来消耗敌人的血条，或者狂喝消耗品来释放你最华丽的伤害技能——你必须使用一套非常精确的工具进行战斗，以应对一套非常特定的攻击模式。再加上有限的治疗、多阶段战斗以及战斗的疯狂流动，很难否认 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 对 Boss 的新处理方式没有追随 FromSoftware 忍者的脚步。

但如果 Capcom 只是照搬流行游戏而不考虑这些想法如何实施，它就不会享有这十年的成功。再次强调，鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 不是一款类魂游戏，你可以从它更广泛的设计中看到这一点。诸如篝火、世界重置和经验值损失等类型规则都不存在。普通敌人如果说有什么特点的话，那就是太简单了。而且视野中没有毒沼泽。虽然这确实导致 Boss 感觉像是战役路线上的重大难度峰值，但它也确保了 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 不会像 FromSoftware 的游戏那样让人感到折磨——即使你在第六次尝试挑战 Boss，也不需要应对令人气愤的跑图过程，这在很大程度上确保了你在面对特别棘手的路障时不会失去耐心。

正是这种对 Capcom 之外想法的优雅改编，确保了 Monster Hunter Stories 3: 命运双龙 和 生化危机4：重制版 都成为了现在的现代巨头。虽然 怪物猎人世界 扩大了视野以允许更广阔的环境，但它小心地没有吸收当代开放世界游戏的臃肿感，它仍然专注于狩猎。生化危机7 云版本 可能采用了 失忆症：黑暗后裔、空匣子 Empty Box 和 异形：隔离 的视角，但它拒绝了它们无战斗的方式，并在你手中放了一把枪——正如 生化危机4：重制版 应该做的那样。在所有这些例子中，很明显 Capcom 既理解每种趋势的大众吸引力，也理解如何以适合相关 IP 的方式重新诠释这种趋势。

虽然 Capcom 对这款沉寂已久的武士游戏的复活是否能像 生化危机4：重制版 和 Monster Hunter Stories 3: 命运双龙 的复兴那样在商业上取得成功还有待观察，但很明显，Capcom 模式在 鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny): Way of the Sword 上运作得非常好。它在发布后获得了近乎一致的媒体好评，其令人印象深刻的发布前试玩版也迅速赢得了大批热心粉丝。运气好的话，鬼武者2 (Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny) 回来了，它的下一部作品将包含任何剑斗版的“贝内文托府邸”。

唐纳德·特朗普的白宫推出了 Arcade.Gov，这是一个包含迷你游戏的网站。在游戏中，玩家可以抓捕并驱逐移民，或者使用 月光下的怪物:方块乱斗 Monsters in the Moonlight: Tetris 方块建造边境墙。
该网站的迷你游戏借鉴了现有创意，例如 Flappy Bill。这显然是对 Flappy Bird 的模仿，要求玩家在飞越国会大厦时保持法案在空中飞行。
与此同时，Rio Run 要求你“沿着河流巡逻，接走每一位越境者”。这本质上是 蛇上而生：序幕 (Above Snakes: Prologue)，你扮演一个穿着西装的角色，收集一串穿着橙色连体衣的囚犯。游戏结束时，屏幕上会显示你成功驱逐的人数。
赢不停。🎮
建造围墙。驱逐。充实特朗普账户。
现在开始游戏 📲 /qIR69AxSnm
Build the Wall: Zombie Border Siege 要求玩家在被称为“南部边境”的地点堆叠砖块并“坚守防线”。这是 月光下的怪物:方块乱斗 Monsters in the Moonlight: Tetris 的一个版本，绿色的外星人会从右侧进入并影响你的方块。
Supply Line 是一款要求你从学校午餐生产线上击飞“冒犯性”食物的游戏，放行蔬菜的同时扔掉能量饮料。最后，Trump Savings Tycoon 让你通过接住从华盛顿特区天际线飘落的模因币和钞票来“充实你孩子的特朗普账户”，背景中的美国国会大厦被一台大型建筑起重机占据。
该网站在社交媒体上投放了广告，视频模仿了 PlayStation 2、Xbox 360 和 Nintendo GameCube 的主机启动动画，以及 Sega 的 Logo（此处被修改为“Maga”）。
对该网站的反应大多如预料之中，而这正是其目的所在。在取悦特朗普支持者的同时，这些游戏显然旨在挑动那些可能认为它们低俗的人的反应。
任天堂是众多指责特朗普政权使用其形象、音乐和知识产权的公司和个人之一，尽管政府似乎并未退缩。同样，这类行为引发的愤怒只会扩大其传播范围，并转移对战争、气候变化等更严肃问题的注意力。

3月，在 Halo 系列中饰演士官长的 Steve Downes 要求白宫从一段社交媒体视频中删除他的声音，他称该视频为“令人恶心的幼稚战争色情片”。去年10月，在唐纳德·特朗普发布了一张将美国总统描绘成士官长的 AI 图像，以及国土安全部使用 Halo 在社交媒体上宣传移民与海关执法局（ICE）后，微软保持了沉默。同样在3月，白宫在社交媒体上发布了一段视频，将伊朗轰炸行动的镜头与 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 的游戏画面混剪在一起。动视对此未予置评。
使命召唤21：黑色行动6
射击, 第一人称射击
在手感上和此前任何一代《使命召唤》都大有不同，甚至我们很难在市面上任何一款FPS中找到同样的设计...
查看更多 立即下载
正如《纽约时报》所指出的，特朗普政府发言人 Abigail Jackson 此前曾发表评论，重申了他们的社交媒体策略。“通过吸引人的帖子和精彩的模因，我们成功地传达了总统极受欢迎的议程，”Jackson 说，“这么多人试图模仿我们的风格是有原因的——我们的信息引起了共鸣。”
总之，很高兴看到大家都在让政治远离游戏。

news.title: 《哈利·波特》剧集多比与少年伏地魔选角揭晓

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260905/QwlcVebubwsybwf.png
HBO 揭晓了其大制作《哈利·波特》剧集第二季的三个关键角色：多比、金妮·韦斯莱以及汤姆·里德尔（即年轻时期的伏地魔）。
17 岁的英国演员、主持人兼喜剧演员莱尼·拉什（Lenny Rush）将饰演家养小精灵多比。该角色在《哈利·波特与密室》中首次登场，并在后续系列中扮演了令人难忘的角色。拉什此前曾出演过英国儿童剧《垃圾场》，也曾参演过《神秘博士》和《任务大师》。
与此同时，汤姆·里德尔将由 18 岁的比利·巴拉特（Billy Barratt）饰演。虽然他还不是家喻户晓的名字，但巴拉特目前正在拍摄 Amazon Prime 改编的热门叙事类视频游戏 奇异人生：双重曝光，并在其中饰演反派（内森·普雷斯科特）。如果你看过《猎人克莱文》，也会看到他饰演年轻的德米特里·斯梅尔佳科夫。
奇异人生：双重曝光

最后，HBO 现已确认新人邦妮·希尔（Bonnie Hill）将从该剧第二季开始饰演金妮·韦斯莱。该角色原先的演员在第一季结束后退出了后续剧集的拍摄。
该剧第二季的制作目前正在进行中，HBO 正努力缩短各季之间的间隔。尽管如此，高层承认该剧不会每年播出，这意味着今年拍摄的剧集可能要到 2028 年才会上映。
回归出演第二季（改编自《哈利·波特与密室》）的演员包括：饰演哈利·波特的多米尼克·麦克劳克林、饰演赫敏·格兰杰的阿拉贝拉·斯坦顿、饰演罗恩·韦斯莱的阿拉斯泰尔·斯托特、饰演阿不思·邓布利多的约翰·利思戈、饰演西弗勒斯·斯内普的帕帕·埃西杜，以及饰演鲁伯·海格的尼克·弗罗斯特。
上个月有消息透露，《权力的游戏》男星基特·哈灵顿将饰演吉德罗·洛哈特——该角色此前曾定由《超人》男星尼古拉斯·霍尔特饰演，但后者因档期问题退出。
HBO 将于今年圣诞节开始播出该剧第一季，剧集将持续播映至 2027 年初。

news.title: 《Project ZETA》开启第二次全球测试 新增2名英雄

content.v: 日前，Krafton发行的在线多人游戏《Project ZETA》开启第二次全球社区测试。本次测试新增2名新英雄，并反映了首次测试中收集的玩家意见，对匹配系统和战斗系统进行了改进。
Project ZETA
MOBA
查看更多 立即下载
《Project ZETA》的第二次全球社区测试于9月4日至6日进行。亚洲地区的匹配在北京时间4日晚7点至6日晚11点之间开放。
新英雄“诺瓦·克拉什”是机甲概念的“战士”职业，擅长以拳头进行近战攻击。使用终极技能“正义冲击”时，可跃向空中后猛击地面，打乱敌方阵型。
同步添加的“阿兹拉凯尔”是大审判官概念的“刺客”职业。玩家可利用瞬移能力在战场上来回穿梭，终极技能“最终判决：抹消”可造成伤害，并立即制服生命值降至一定水平以下的敌人。
匹配系统引入了“段位系统”，帮助实力相近的玩家匹配对战。为增强即使比赛初期出现差距也能翻盘的可能性，强化了成长结构，并提高了获取难度较高的“超级棱镜”的比重，使领先队伍不易轻易锁定胜局。
打击感、操控感、移动速度及死亡时的演出效果也进行了调整。为提升玩家便利性，UI也进行了全新改版，整体游戏完成度得到改善。
Nirvanana工作室CEO金南锡表示：“本次版本中，我们将通过新英雄带来新的游戏体验，并改进为即使出现差距也能实现逆转，从而提升了紧张感。”他接着表示：“玩家们的反馈正在推动《Project ZETA》的成长，敬请大家期待更加完善的面貌。”
《Project ZETA》是由Nirvanana工作室开发、Krafton发行的多团队战术竞技场（Multi-team Tactical Arena）类型的在线多人游戏。3人组成一队，共4支队伍在同一战场中围绕“棱镜”展开实时竞争。
战斗采用第三人称动作方式，利用各英雄的专属技能进行。游戏提供分属4个职业的16种英雄，并支持手柄操作。
全球测试的参与申请可通过Steam商店页面进行。

news.title: 韩国足球新作《自由足球2》开启测试 视频放出

content.v: JoyCity携足球游戏新作《自由足球2》亮相北美游戏展。公司在“PAX West 2026”设立独立试玩展位，并面向PC和主机玩家开启Prime公开测试。
PAX West 2026从9月4日至7日在美国西雅图举行。《自由足球2》将在展会现场设立独立试玩展位，为全球观众提供直接体验游戏的机会。
现场试玩将展示5v5团队对战模式，由担任不同位置的玩家分别操控一名角色进行竞技。玩家可体验快节奏的比赛进程、各位置的角色分工以及基于团队协作的策略性玩法。
JoyCity在提供线下试玩的同时，还将于9月4日起开启Prime公开测试（以下简称Prime OBT）。Prime OBT面向PC和主机平台，将反映此前测试中收集的玩家意见，提供在游戏性、便利性和系统整体上得到改进的版本。
《自由足球2》是JoyCity旗下《FreeStyle》系列开发团队参与制作的新作。游戏以5v5对战模式、个性鲜明的角色、按位置划分职责以及策略性团队协作为核心要素。
JoyCity将通过参加PAX West和Prime OBT扩大与全球玩家的接触点，并计划于年内正式发布《自由足球2》。

news.title: After a massive 2021 office expansion, Bungie is now trying to sublease its 211,000 square foot headquarters
news.summary: Bungie says it "will continue to maintain a physical office presence in Bellevue."

content.v: In 2021, as studio CEO Pete Parsons cited the company's recent "tremendous growth and opportunity," Bungie announced its plans for a massive expansion to its Bellevue, Washington headquarters . The campus embiggening, which internal sources have reportedly described as costing "hundreds of millions" of dollars, more than doubled the size of Bungie's offices from 84,000 square feet to just under 211,000.

Now, after five and a half years of spending sprees, publisher acquisitions, stumbling product launches, project cancellations, and repeated mass layoffs, Bungie appears to be seeking subletters for the goliath game development headquarters it's no longer capable of filling.

According to a 10-page leasing brochure reviewed by The Game Post , Bungie is seeking interested renters to sublease its expansive headquarters, listing its 210,984 square feet as a "turn-key" production facility. In addition to expected office fixtures, the listing also features a dedicated lobby, gym and exercise facilities (including a rock climbing wall), a motion-capture studio, a cafe, catering space, and a private exterior patio.
While the brochure didn't directly identify the studio, a statement provided to press verified that Bungie was actively pursuing a sublease.

"Bungie is exploring options to sublease its campus in Bellevue, Washington. The studio transitioned to a digital-first model several years ago, and this move reflects the team's evolving workplace needs and the effectiveness of its remote collaboration," Bungie said. "Bungie will continue to maintain a physical office presence in Bellevue."

Bungie formally adopted remote work eligibility for most of its roles in 2022, following the studio's shift to work-from-home development during the COVID-19 lockdown years—effectively defeating the purpose of its office expansion due to circumstances that would have been impossible to predict during its early planning stages.

Bungie wasn't the only games company to make ill-fated investments during the height of the pandemic: Analysts have repeatedly cited overly-ambitious expansions and acquisitions—propelled by the COVID era's low interests rates and explosion of at-home entertainment revenue—as one of the driving forces behind the games industry's brutal cost-cutting in the years that followed.

Bungie's overextension, however, was particularly drastic. After Sony purchased the studio for $3.6 billion in 2022 , Bungie leadership embarked on a rampant hiring spree, adding hundreds of developers to the payroll to fill out development teams for a swath of simultaneous incubation projects—projects that would prove unsustainable as the impact of Covid waned and revenues started to tumble across the industry.

A mass layoff followed in October 2023 , affecting roughly 100 employees. The next round cut 220 developers in July 2024 as fallout from Bungie leadership having reportedly "overstated their studio’s financial prospects to Sony," leading to a dire enough fiscal outlook that even the success of Destiny 2's Final Shape expansion couldn't salvage it. As Sony intensified its oversight amidst the mounting turmoil, Bungie's leadership began to abandon ship, culminating with Pete Parsons departing the studio in 2025—presumably in one of his vintage collector cars .

Bungie staff ultimately suffered another sweeping layoff in June 2026, with most of the Destiny team losing their jobs in the aftermath of Destiny 2's end of live service. At peak employment, Bungie's staff numbered over 1,600; in July 2024, Parsons said the studio numbered around 850 . The WARN notice issued for this June's layoff indicated at least 292 jobs were affected.
In other words, if all of Bungie's remaining employees gathered in its office, there would be fewer than 600 people to fill its 211,000 square feet.
If you're interested, the master lease runs through September 30, 2035.

news.title: 白宫推出了在线“街机”，其中有自己的俄罗斯方块和其他流行游戏，但它和你想象的一样糟糕
news.summary: The arcade currently includes games based on Tetris, Flappy Bird, and Snake, and of course a healthy dose of r

content.v: The White House, the epicenter of power in the most powerful nation in human history, has rolled out a new online arcade on its website. And yes, it is every bit as racist, repugnant, and creatively bankrupt as you'd expect.

We'll set aside the question of "why?" for now and get straight to the games, beginning with Flappy Bill, a game in which you fly a bald eagle down the National Mall. It's not clear whether the bird's name is actually Bill because it's also carrying a bill, which my young years of being exposed to Schoolhouse Rock from across the border taught me is part of the US lawmaking process, or at least used to be before they decided that having the president do everything by fiat is more efficient or something. In any event, it's an entirely unremarkable Flappy Bird clone, innocuous but about as much fun as tying a shoelace.

The tone takes a hard turn to the right with the next game, Build the Wall: Zombie Border Siege, a Tetris knock-off where you'll "protect the border from the coming horde." To ensure there's no misunderstanding the nature of this horde, the game's backdrop is a retro-future take on the sun setting over a barren desert—and in case that's too subtle, there's also a sign that says "Southern Border."

One notable thing about this one is that unlike actual Tetris, the lines don't disappear when they're completed. Instead, they just stack up until they reach the top, at which point it's inevitably game over no matter how neatly you've arranged things. A slow-moving line of "zombies" moves across the bottom of the screen, and they are capable of getting past your wall if you haven't built it high enough—but "high enough" is literally two stacked tetrominoes, after which nothing can get past. So I'm not sure what the point is there, except to be really racist and xenophobic, I suppose.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4cqz6PSMDtuDVvDK8LEGy5.png

Moving on: The third game in the White House Arcade is called Rio Run, a recreation of a "border patrol along the Rio Grande" based on the ancient classic Snake. As a balding white guy in a suit, you pick up brown-skinned people one at a time, each of whom joins a train behind you wearing shackles and an orange jumpsuit. Once the game ends, when you run into a wall or your train of prisoners, they're all deported and you're encouraged to try again. Lovely.

I don't really know what to make of the fourth game. Supply Line, as it's called, charges you to "sort the school line to make America healthy again" by letting 'good' food ride a conveyor belt to the school lunch box, while chucking 'bad' food—anything with coloring, additives, sealed packages, or seed oils—into the "reject" box.

This one was a little tricky at first because the low-effort graphics make it difficult to tell good food from bad (as the concept is envisioned by Robert F. Kennedy Jr), but what's really bizarre is the muscular Black man in boxing gloves standing in the background. Every time I let a bad bit of food slip past, he punched the back of my monitor. Four punches and it was game over, although oddly enough he's the one who took the actual damage.
Also, reading labels is apparently bad, according to a sign with a red strike through it. Ain't that America? For you and me, baby.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MVjJJ3wUc2bDp2X83dVGh5.png

The fifth and final game on the White Hours Arcade tour is Trump Savings Tycoon, a game about filling your kids' Trump Accounts , which are basically retirement savings accounts for children, backed by money from various super-wealthy individuals like Jensen Huang and Michael Dell who may or may not have anything to gain from big-money sycophancy.

This game involves simply clicking on various money-esque objects with a net as they fly across the sky. It's maybe the simplest of the bunch mechanically, but the clicking is extremely imprecise so it doesn't take long before three objects are missed and it's game over.

More interesting to me is the background, which features the Reflecting Pool (a perfectly lovely shade of blue, unlike its real-world counterpart ) and a massive construction crane looming over the Washington DC skyline, presumably indicating optimism about the president's planned ballroom/bunker. There's also a small convoy of what appears to be flying police cars that goes soaring across the sky every now and then. I have no theories about what that might be about.

In case it wasn't sufficiently clear, these things are universally bad, both conceptually and in execution: If you're going to rip off the world's most famous stacking game to promote your racist agenda, for instance, you should at least make it play like that game. It's an astonishingly lazy effort, and I can't shake the feeling that all of these games were vibe-coded, maybe by some DOGE hanger-on they found hiding in the bathroom.

The obvious question is, as noted earlier, is why? Who are these games for? I think the answer in one sense is that they're for no one in particular, but are instead just another wave in the flood of sewage pumped out every day by the US president and his administration. Over the last couple years, the US government has posted numerous gaming-related memes , video clips , and AI generated images to promote its leader and his agenda.
But more broadly, this effort is targeted at the young male gamer demographic, at least in part to leverage the political influence it first demonstrated during the Gamergate harassment campaign.

George E. Osborn, author of Power Play: Videogames, Politics, and the Battle for Global Influence , wrote on his Videogames Industry Memo blog (via The Guardian ) that "the content works because it does what a lot of good social content does. It riffs on widely known popular culture to get cut through in the way many popular memes do. It has a chaotic, anarchic tone which suits the channel it's in. It is transgressive in a way that delights the administration's supporters and infuriates its rivals. And it feels all the more edgy because the formerly stuffy White House social channels have been turned into a place where this kind of stuff circulates freely.

"A big chunk of the modern political right in America emerged from Gamergate. The hate movement was brought into the political fold by Steve Bannon and Breitbart after it showed how it is possible to wash extreme talking points into the mainstream political environment. Its members became online 'shock troopers' for Trump, as well as becoming foundational figures in the alt-right and nuttier fringes like QAnon. And as they've grown up, the almost entirely young men who made waves back in 2014 are now in positions of power on the right. This allows them to shape the online narrative, encouraging them to reach a fresh generation of men through an increasingly fragmented social media ecosystem that allows transgressive macho 'manosphere' content to trend."

The US government shows no sign of easing off on these behaviors. Posts on X promoting the new arcade site include animations using the Xbox, Nintendo, and Sega logos, the latter of which was probably chosen because it morphs well into "MAGA."

news.summary: Official Tetris pages have responded after the Trump administration launched a clone video game called 'Build

content.v: https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2019/03/18/tetris-1552946351175.jpg
Official Tetris pages have responded after the Trump administration launched a clone video game called 'Build the Wall.'

The Tetris Company joined the backlash after Donald Trump's White House published its Arcade.Gov website today. Amongst a line of games on offer, which includes a Flappy Bird clone called 'Flappy Bill' and a Snake clone called 'Rio Run,' is Build the Wall.
A description for the game follows: "Protect the border from the coming horde." It's a message that Tetris wants absolutely nothing to do with.

"At Tetris we believe in the power of connection and bringing people together, not dividing them," it said. "To our fans everywhere: we love you, we see you, and we're grateful to have you in our community."

Tetris continued, confirming that it had nothing to do with the Trump administration's Build the Wall game. It also added, "We take copyright infringement very seriously." The Tetris Company does not seem to have taken any sort of legal action against the arcade page yet.

The White House launched its website yesterday. It contains five games, including titles asking players to "border patrol along the Rio Grande" and "fill your kids' Trump accounts." It also warned that more games are coming soon.

Arcade.Gov immediately faced backlash from users online. Many have called on companies pulled from the site's reveal video, including Tetris and Sega, to take action. Although the latter has yet to chime in, Tetris is being quite vocal – and so are its fans. Some of its statement's top comments note that games such as this are typically about breaking walls, not building them. Others are just happy to see Tetris speaking up.
CAN'T STOP WINNING. 🎮 Build the wall. Deport. Fill a Trump Account. LIVE - PLAY NOW 📲 https://t.co/qIR69AxSnm pic.twitter.com/2nr2jG1ZRg

The Tetris Company's Kerri Brusca also provided The Verge with a statement on the matter: "For more than 40 years, Tetris has brought people together across generations and cultures through play and joy. The objective of the game has always been to stack with purpose to clear as many lines as possible. We are currently reviewing the matter."

IGN reported on the site's original launch earlier today. The Trump administration has stirred controversy with similar moves in the past, including posts referencing the Halo series . Although Microsoft was silent on that matter, The Pokémon Company and Master Chief actor Steve Downes are amongst those who have spoken up .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

news.title: 本周值得观看的 9 个游戏和电影预告片
news.summary: Street Fighter, Stranger Than Heaven, buzzy festival movies, horror schlock, a super-stylish indie, and more.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/noah-sf-1788553514117.png

Despite Sony’s double State of Play this week being a little bit of a dud — though did you catch the hard-as-hell new Resident Evil clip at the very beginning? — the trailer-sphere nonetheless kept chugging along as it always does. We got a new look at Street Fighter and a bunch more trailers ahead of Venice and Toronto Film Festivals for movies that are already catching Oscar buzz, a holdover from gamescom, and an indie game that caught my attention at the Tribeca Festival this past summer. These are the trailers worth checking out this week (and here’s what you missed last week ).
Street Fighter

It’s been about four months since the last Street Fighter trailer, and with a little more than a month before release, I’m excited we got another 3-ish minute taste of what to expect from the Kitao Sakurai-directed movie. I might never not be taken aback by blond Noah Centineo as Ken, but the tone of this movie remains convincingly super fun. Like Eric Andre spittles in the new trailer, “This is STREET FIGHTERRRRR!”
Street Fighter releases in theaters October 16.
Stranger Than Heaven official gameplay

As a member of the RGG hive — if this isn’t you, you’re making a big mistake with your life — this extended look at the environments and fight mechanics of the not-Yakuza-prequel game Stranger Than Heaven from gamescom has me mega-hyped. As we’ve already previewed out of SGF , the combat definitely looks more difficult than RGG’s other non-turn-based games, but I’m glad they still found a way to make early-to-mid-1900s street goons look nearly as ridiculous as present-day Kamurocho.
Stranger Than Heaven releases on PS5, Xbox X|S, and PC on January 15, 2027.
Ink

Jack O’Connell, Guy Pearce, and Claire Foy star in INK, from Academy Award-winning director Danny Boyle. A group of visionaries and misfits had an idea for a new kind of news — one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today.… pic.twitter.com/5EHsGjl0Pl

Danny Boyle seems to have locked the eff in for Ink, starring Jack O’Connell and Guy Pearce, who are both always locked in, as Larry Lamb and Rupert Murdoch as they orchestrate the salacious relaunch of the British tabloid The Sun while Claire Foy tries to talk some sense into them. Maybe it’s too on the nose for a media person to be excited about a media movie, but Ink, which just premiered at the Venice Film Festival, has me hooked.
Ink releases in theaters December 11 before coming to Netflix on January 8.
Until Dawn 2

The first look at Until Dawn 2 in Sony’s June State of Play gave very little in the way of “what are we getting into here?” This new clip from this week’s presentation revealed the release date and more about the concept: It’s set during a reality-show shoot on a haunted tropical island where the slimy host/producer goads the cast into messy situations that you, the player, need to decide how to react.
Until Dawn 2 releases on PS5 January 28, 2027.
Rhapsody in Scarlet

Konami’s new game reveal: Baffling! Sign me up. Set in the 1920s jazz scene in New York City, Rhapsody in Scarlet is an action game where the characters use magic and direct large beasts to fight, I guess. Again, very jazzy. I’m intrigued.
Rhapsody in Scarlet doesn’t have a release window yet.
Pendulum

A horror movie? Releasing on January 1??? There’s absolutely no way this movie, written and directed by Black Swan co-writer Mark Heyman, is going to be making year-end lists in 2027, but it seems like a wellness cult movie that’ll make the winter movie graveyard a little more fun. Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Norman Reedus, and Phoebe Dynevor star.
Pendulum releases in theaters January 1.
Rebounder

I got to play a demo of Rebounder at the Tribeca Festival this summer and it was easily among my favorite games. It’s a tricky but addicting precision platformer rocking an insanely cool hyper-stylized, newspaper comics-print art direction as you bounce around an alien planet in an astronaut suit. The new trailer came with the announcement that Rebounder is being published by Aggro Crab, which also put out the viral friendslop (affectionately) game Peak.
Rebounder releases on Steam in 2027.
La Bola Negra

LA BOLA NEGRA tells the story of three generations of men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain, and love. Starring Spanish music sensation Guitarricadelafuente, Miguel Bernardeau, Carlos González, Milo Quifes, Lola Dueñas, Julio Torres, Penélope Cruz and… pic.twitter.com/inXEYsrRE8

La Bola Negra’s directors Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi won the best directing award at Cannes, where it premiered. The Spanish-language film, following three generations of men across three era-defining years in Spain’s history, has since been celebrated as an early Oscar lock. Netflix certainly has high hopes for it: The streamer is giving it a chunky qualifying theatrical run, with no streaming date attached yet.
La Bola Negra releases in theaters October 16 before coming to Netflix some time this fall.
The Unknown

Léa Seydoux stars alongside Neils Schneider in this French-language body-swap horror written and directed by the Oscar-winning screenwriter of Anatomy of a Fall, Arthur Harari. This first teaser is short, sub-2 minutes, but this highlight reel of Seydoux’s reactions has me sold. (Also, people who reviewed it out of Cannes had nice things to say about it; it’ll make the rounds at the Toronto and New York film festivals.)
The Unknown doesn’t have a release date yet.
Leanne Butkovic (she/they) is an Editorial Programming Manager at IGN, where they've also written about TV, movies, and games.

news.title: 我：您现在可以在 AMD GPU 上运行 DLSS 5。我的 RX 9070 XT：请停下来，这伤害了我们
news.summary: A new app allows you to inject DLSS Neural Rendering deep into games even if you're running an AMD card. You p

content.v: Another day, another DLSS 5 story that actually kinda doesn't involve Nvidia itself doing anything, because it seems now AMD GPU owners can get in on the act. A new homebrew app has been released on Github that will allow you to run the DLSS Neural Rendering feature on a Radeon GPU. I've tried it and it works, but damn does it hurt the poor Radeon silicon.

From having DLSS 5 .dll files plucked from an early access version of NBA 2K27, we've had modders working hard to create surprisingly polished ways to essentially get the tech working in practically any game , even if it doesn't natively support traditional DLSS itself.

I've been playing around with it a lot this past week, even to the point of jamming it into Football Manager 26 just to see what would happen. And, y'know what, I kinda like the result so I'm keeping it. I wasn't expecting that, and I also wasn't expecting this technology, created by Nvidia, to appear so quickly on AMD GPUs. Historically we've found that where Nvidia goes, so AMD follows, at least in the GPU feature space, but it seems like AMD might not actually have to do much this time. Well, apart from actually make the silicon a little more tensor-friendly.

Because I have spent the afternoon trying to get the new app from user danielblnc on Github to work on my Radeon RX 9070 XT in Cyberpunk 2077. Essentially you download the DLSS-NR-on-AMD file, drop it into the relevant folder (the bin/x64 folder in the Cyberpunk 2077 directory in Steam, for example) and run it. So long as you have the necessary nvngx_dlssnr.dll file that's been doing the rounds installed in the same place it ought to work.
It didn't.

Initially Windows flagged it as containing a virus, but I did some checking around with VirusTotal and seemingly the Defender flag is a machine learning false positive. Probably. But even then I still struggled to have it running happily.

I am not entirely sure what I did wrong, but when I enabled the feature in-game all I got was a black output where the 3D world ought to be, even though the HUD and game kept on running. After some file deletion, redownloading, verifying of integrity (mine and Cyberpunk's), and a rollback of my AMD Adrenalin drivers, I finally got it working. Kinda. I mean it's still kinda crashy, and I can only now launch Cyberpunk 2077 directly from the .exe file rather than from Steam, but it works.

But my poor GPU wished I hadn't. Now, we know that DLSS 5 is a hell of a resource hog on an RTX 50-series GPU that it's designed for, with a touted 50 - 60% performance hit officially noted by Nvidia , so I should have known it would trouble the AMD GPU.
DLSS NR on Nvidia
DLSS 5 was designed for GeForce GPUs, so is a little more capable, but still a massive resource hog.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/B3ULyP68EiAPD55fRNR8S7.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HY5MBFRknD6or3SV8M3eP7.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bkwSqn4ocKYaQwBeFt2HHb.png

Still… running at 4K RT Ultra settings is tough enough, and I was getting just 61 fps on the RX 9070 XT even with FSR 4 set to Balanced. And then flicking the DLSS Neural Rendering toggle to 'on' made that figure drop to just 9 fps.
And I thought the 73% drop Andy found with NBA 2K27 was rough.
DLSS NR on AMD
AMD GPUs running DLSS 5 looks great, but runs horribly.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GdUR8M8koZZwGPhmTxDmN8.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FqdP8wjrhsx4LHcLV63wH8.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bkwSqn4ocKYaQwBeFt2HHb.png

Now it's worth noting that the fact it is running at all on AMD GPUs is impressive on its own, but it's not going to make any Radeon graphics card owners any happier about it when they're getting unplayable frame rates out of their new ill-gotten pretties. An 85% performance drop is not sustainable. Nice for screenshots though, eh?
The issue is that AMD's RDNA 4 doesn't have the level of dedicated silicon for the sort of matrix calculations the feature is running… in the same way that RTX 20-series chips don't.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/izPy8MckiwADhpps9hdzR8.jpg

The Turing architecture does have Tensor Cores, but they're far weaker compared to those in the RTX 40- or RTX 50-series, and the shared resources AMD plucks from the standard RDNA 4 Compute Units for these sorts of calculations aren't as robust either. Hence the weaker performance.

Will they be able to squeeze more performance out of this feature on AMD chips? I don't know, but YouTuber Ancient Gameplays noted the app in a recent video, and states that performance has gone up 12% since the first version of the DLSS-NR-on-AMD software first hit Github, so maybe there's a chance. But, realistically, I think there's a hard hardware limit in there which is going to stop DLSS Neural Rendering from being a realistic part of AMD's armoury in this generation.

news.title: Rockstar 审查《侠盗猎车手 6》中国版加长版预告片
news.summary: Rockstar Games has published a heavily censored version of the Grand Theft Auto 6 extended look reveal for Chi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/gta-6-gameplay-blog-1787861652027.jpg
Rockstar Games has published a heavily censored version of the Grand Theft Auto 6 extended look reveal for China.

As shared by @videotech on X/Twitter , the studio behind the game that is convincing publishers to steer clear of November published its 27-minute gameplay reveal on Chinese social media platform Bilibili last week – but some things are just a bit different from other uploads (via Kotaku ). It doesn't take long to realize that large portions of the GTA 6 trailer have been blurred out, including dancing, drug-related content, and sexual content.

Considering this is a Grand Theft Auto game, there's quite a bit you can't see. Footage of protagonists Jason and Lucia at a nightclub, for example, basically turns the screen into a giant purple blur. A later scene blurs out Jason's hand when he's smoking, while brief shots of the beach censor some of the crowd. While most corpses seem unblurred, footage showing close-ups of bloodied dead bodies has also been completely censored.

It's a very different look at GTA 6, but the video wasn't originally the blurry mess we see here. As spotted by GTAForums user BDF , this reportedly isn't the same video Rockstar originally uploaded following GTA 6: Extended Look's Netflix premiere.
The first upload supposedly didn't have the same censoring it does now. Rockstar is said to have altered the video around August 31. The reasoning behind the delayed adjustments is unclear.

BDF noted that the changes have split users on China's Reddit-like platform, Tieba, and other online communities. While some suspect Rockstar censored GTA 6 to keep younger users from viewing the trailer's contents, others believe the move reflects prejudice from Rockstar and parent company Take-Two Interactive. BDF also reported that Rockstar and Take-Two have issued DMCA takedowns for those reposting unblurred content on Bilibili.

Censored or not, the floodgates for GTA 6 seem to officially be open ahead of its November 19 launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X | S. New Vice City-themed PS5 controllers were revealed just yesterday, additional screenshots were posted on Rockstar's website earlier this week, and fans are still combing through every detail from last week's big gameplay reveal .
There will surely be plenty more to show before that release date finally rolls around. Until then, you can see IGN's coverage, including our preview and interview with the team at Rockstar.

news.title: 即将推出的 Nintendo Switch 2 游戏：2026 年及以后的发布日期
news.summary: Building up the Switch 2 library.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/01/23/switch2games-1769208267817.jpg
We now have our hands on the Nintendo Switch 2 , a new console from one of the biggest names in gaming. Alas, a new console is only as valuable as the library of games you can build on it.

Thankfully, Nintendo hasn't been shy about planned releases over the next year. In the second half of 2026, we'll be getting our hands on a mix of Switch 2 exclusives, third-party releases, and the benefit of backward compatibility with any games still launching on the original Switch. Without further ado, here are all of the new Switch 2 games we can look forward to in 2026 and beyond.
All Upcoming Switch 2 Games With Release Dates
* indicates a Switch 2 exclusive
Mewgenics (September 8, 2026)

From the same creator as The Binding of Isaac, which is also making its way to Switch 2 later in the year, Mewgenics is a turn-based strategy game that’s all about breeding cats and battling nasty things. We gave it a very solid 9/10 when it first launched on PC earlier this year, saying it's "good for more than a hundred hours of roguelike runs." It also has some very catchy music.
The Switch 2 edition of Mewgenics will also be getting a physical cartridge release at some point in early 2027.
RuneScape: Dragonwilds (September 15, 2026)
RuneScape got a bit of a makeover with this new open world crafting and survival game that was initially released last year, and is finally coming to Switch 2 this fall.
Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave (September 17, 2026)*

We finally have a release date for the next game in the Fire Emblem series, which already happens to be available to preorder . Here’s a snippet of what to expect from the official Nintendo listing : “Worthy fighters from all over the land have come to Dagsion, the capital city of the Dagdan Empire, to compete in the Heroic Games for the chance to win one wish. Among the combatants are four heroes tied to the fate of the world.” You can learn more about how the game balances those four heroes in our hands-on preview .
Trine 6: Together in Time (September 17, 2026)

If you’re looking for a cozy platformer you can play with a friend, Trine 6 might have you covered. The latest side-scrolling sequel from FrozenByte is designed with co-op in mind, so you can test your friendship on movement combos and puzzles.
Another Eden Begins (September 17, 2026)

From Masato Kato, the writer behind Chrono Trigger, comes Another Eden Begins, a completely fresh RPG that takes you on a journey across the past, present, and future. Recruit companions from a roster of 18 characters to help you take down the Beast King and find your sister. This one’s got a whopping 10 endings on the menu, though I’m sure some of those are reserved for New Game+.
LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight (September 18, 2026)

The latest LEGO game finally has a Switch 2 release date. LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is truly next level . It blends and parodies classic Batman moments from across all iterations of the caped crusader while also offering a pretty massive plastic version of Arkham to play around in. Even the combat is pretty elaborate, with inspiration from the Arkham games courtesy of development support from Rocksteady Studios.
SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance (September 24, 2026)

SEGA brought back its Shinobi series with the action platformer Art of Vengeance in 2025. We called the new release “a genuinely engaging 2D action platformer that’s beautiful to behold and even better to play” in our review , and it’ll be getting a Switch 2 port later this year.
Minecraft Dungeons II (September 29, 2026)

We called the first Minecraft Dungeons game a “fun dungeon crawler with a simple but tried-and-true set of systems.” The sequel, developed by Mojang and published by Xbox, will be launching across platforms, including Switch 2, this September . Like the first game, the block-based dungeon crawler will support both local and online multiplayer.
007 First Light (September 30, 2026)

Yet another massive multi-platform release, IO Interactive's take on James Bond is launching on Switch 2 several months after its initial release on PC, PS5, and Xbox in late May. The game lets you play out Bond's initial recruitment and rise in the MI6 ranks, featuring Patrick Gibson as the titular spy and Lenny Kravitz as the villain Bawma .
Octopath Traveler I & II - Switch 2 Editions (October 1, 2026)

Following the release of Octopath Traveler 0 , Square Enix is releasing fresh Switch 2 editions of the original two games that defined the HD-2D style. We were big fans of both, for what it’s worth, with IGN’s Seth Macy praising how the first game “pushes JRPGs forward rather than simply paying homage to the greats” in his 9/10 review .
Rayman Legends Retold (October 1, 2026)
Remakes truly are all the rage right now. This one is a 3D reimagining of 2013’s Rayman Legends, which we called a “work of platforming genius” in our original 9.5/10 review .
Kingdom Hearts Collection [I~III] (October 8, 2026)

The Switch 2 will be getting fresh editions of existing Kingdom Hearts games, which will replace the existing ‘ Cloud streaming’ versions that were available on the Switch. Those Cloud versions were notoriously… not great, so here’s to hoping this gives everyone a better shot at the series ahead of Kingdom Hearts 4 . The three collections will be available individually or as one big bundle.
Hell is Us (October 8, 2026)

Hell is Us, from studio Rogue Factor, was originally released almost exactly year ago. In the words of our review , the game “has a blend of exploration, puzzles, and combat that, while familiar, pushes you to really pay attention to the world around you in a way that’s both compelling and occasionally frustrating."
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen (October 9, 2026)

Capcom’s RPG sequel is getting a new ‘Dark Arisen’ edition with fresh content and QOL improvements as it launches on the Switch 2. Jarrett Green reviewed the game for IGN when it was first released on PC, saying that it’s more than anything “a retelling and reimplementation of… wonderful ideas from the 2012 cult-classic.”
The Witch’s Bakery (October 14, 2026)

For the cozy gamers, The Witch’s Bakery places you in control of Lunne, a young witch who’s opening a new bakery in Paris. In the vein of something like Dave the Diver, each in-game day is split into multiple phases of managing your bakery and exploring the town while also using your magic to help your friends.
Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse (October 15, 2026)

The first 2D Castlevania game in almost 20 years narratively follows Castlevania 3: Dracula’s Curse, taking place a little over decade after that one’s story (which also serves as inspiration for the animated Netflix series). Mitchell Saltzman got the chance to preview the game for IGN , with particular praise for the combat, saying there’s “plenty of room to carve out your own personal playstyle thanks to the variety of weapons, Arcana, and relics.”
Tales of Eternia Remastered (October 16, 2026)

Tales of Eternia is getting a remake and returning to its original title. Previously localized as Tales of Destiny II in North America, Eternia was first released for the PS2 back in the 2000 as the third game in Namco’s Tales series.

news.summary: Xbox owners can save $10 on Grand Theft Auto 6's ultimate edition using this simple workaround (but it's only

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/untitled-design-1788544409551.png

Here’s a good deal for any Xbox Series X|S owner who hasn’t preordered Grand Theft Auto 6 yet. Today only, by taking advantage of an Xbox gift card deal at Newegg , you can effectively knock $10 off the price of GTA 6.

How does it work, you ask? Newegg is offering $5 off $50 Xbox gift cards if you enter promo code LDSF373 at checkout . Thankfully, the code stacks, so you can add two gift cards to your cart to get $10 off $100 worth of credit.

As luck would have it, the ultimate edition of GTA 6, the one most people are buying , is available to preorder on Xbox for $99.99 . Put it all together, and you effectively save $10 off GTA 6. But remember, the deal is good today only.

We had only gotten a sprinkling of specifics about GTA 6 over the past few years until last week’s extended look blew the game open with 27 minutes of frankly awesome-looking gameplay footage. IGN’s own Rachel Weber got to see a lot more than those 27 minutes of the game, and also got to chat with the co-studio head Rob Nelson about it. Check out her preview for a ton of new GTA 6 info.

news.title: DLSS 5 毕竟会出现在较旧的显卡上
news.summary: On Nvidia's forums, an Nvidia employee claimed that the company will be expanding DLSS 5 support to RTX 40 ser

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/03/23/jensen-gpu-1774306276198.png
Nvidia's DLSS 5 neural rendering tech officially debuted yesterday in NBA 2K27, and it's only supported on current-generation RTX 5000 graphics cards. But it seems like that'll change over time.

On Nvidia's forums, an employee claimed that the company will be expanding DLSS 5 support to RTX 40 series graphics cards at some point, but we're probably going to wait a while for it. He said, "Our current focus is on optimizing performance for the GeForce RTX 50 Series with model updates expected later this fall," but noted that "once RTX 50 Series performance is more fully tuned, we plan to work on expanding official support to the GeForce RTX 40 Series."

So, it seems like the company's focus, at least for now, is to get it running smoother on current-generation graphics cards before retrofitting it to its Ada Lovelace architecture. That makes a lot of sense, too. I've briefly messed around with the technology in NBA 2K27, and I was surprised by how subtle the changes were, at least compared to some of the nightmare fuel I've seen on Reddit. But even though the technology did make NBA 2K27 look better, it had a massive impact to performance, and I was testing it on an RTX 5090 .

Turning on DLSS 5 on my main system brought the pre-frame-gen frame rate down from around 57-60 fps down to around 37 fps, a pretty massive 43% performance drop. If that's the performance hit on the most powerful graphics card on the market, I'm not confident about how well something like the RTX 4080 would handle it, especially with its older Tensor Cores.

It's clear that Nvidia has made a lot of headway in optimizing the technology since it was first revealed back in March, though. Back then, Nvidia needed two RTX 5090s to even run it, and now Team Green claims that it has improved model performance by around 5x. There's a possibility that with enough optimization, the performance hit will shrink over time. But, until I actually see that, I'm going to remain skeptical.
Jackie Thomas is the Senior Tech Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. You can follow her @Jackiecobra

content.v: It took me quite a while to work out all The Blood of Dawnwalker endings . Similar to The Witcher 3, there are a fair few different options, each with a number of variables that can change based on your choices. There are also some secret endings to discover.
Obviously, this guide will contain spoilers for just about everything, you've been warned. Here's each ending, how they work, plus a short explainer about the epilogue and its different outcomes.
All Blood of Dawnwalker endings
There are seven possible endings to Blood of Dawnwalker.
Also two additional notes:

All endings, except for one of the secret ones, involve an epilogue sequence which runs through decisions you made throughout the game—and there are some big differences, but I'll explain all of those in the epilogue section at the end if you're curious. Side note, make sure to have 800 Denarius on hand for any ending involving the epilogue , as the church will ask for a donation and you can give your sister Yanna a dowry.
Assaulting Griefberg Castle
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UyPkx27rQ7fixw27odnigB.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/29Qdjrf6oG9ewXLgpiHtMH.jpg
Four of the game's endings begin with assaulting Griefberg Castle, and in every version, your assault changes based on a few key variables:
Below, I'll run through each variation of the castle assault.
A Lone Wolf's Hunt
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dKoM7QXNMeePjoNQUU5xvc.jpg
Coen takes the fight to Brencis by himself.

Shadow Step over the wall of Griefberg Castle at nighttime. Or find Father Florin's hideout in Svartrau cathedral, track him down, and complete A Hero's End, which unlocks the ability to enter the castle in the day using a password at a sidedoor.

This ending sees Coen assault Griefberg Castle by himself at either day or night, depending on which of the above you approach. If you do fight Ambrus, Bakir, or Xanthe, you won't be able to drink their Vrakhir blood and gain their abilities if it's daytime, or invite them in, and will instead just kill them.

First off, you always have to fight the Unblinking Blasphemy boss, even if you completed the Who Pulls the Strings quest for the Manumits. You battle through the castle, free some prisoners by unlocking their cells, and eventually confront Brencis in the dungeon depths, just in time to save your family.

You can either fight Brencis here, or make a deal with him if you agree to bow and give up either Crake and the Manumits, or Lacra, though if it's the former, you'll have to go their hideout and mark it, as in the A Deal With the Devil ending (I'll explain that one in its dedicated section below).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WJz3i3DkaqLVSK5p9vNctc.jpg

If not, you'll fight and defeat Brencis, and choose whether to invite him in, or leave him in Anachora (vampire hell) to have his soul devoured. After this, the epilogue sequence in Laslea will begin.

This is genuinely one of my favorite endings—Vale Sangora becomes independent and there's some degree of lawlessness, but the Manumits protect the valley from the worst enterprising ruffians. You can read a proclamation on a tree in Laslea explaining that Svatrau city council plans to petition Bohemia, Hungary, or Poland to join their realms in the spring.

Since there are no more Vrakhiri, the plague returns, the Uriashi return to their villages, but Christianity also returns, the cathedral is restored, and Father Florin becomes a saint. I'm sure you're thinking " That's a good ending??" but just wait until I explain the others.
Rise At Dawn, Fall Before Dusk
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4fRTiVosLRDw2tSSKk8cqH.jpg
Coen helps Crake and the Manumits restore Catalin Dragosti to power.
Join the Manumits via The Firebrand, Shadows in the Woods, and Where Loyalty Lies , and then follow the questline until you complete Who Pulls the Strings.
In this ending, Crake explains that Catalin Dragosti (the son of Vale Sangora's former tyrant) is waiting outside the valley with an army, and you attack Eastridge Outpost to let him in.

Unsurprisingly, Catalin Dragosti is as bloodthirsty as his father and immediately executes some defenceless prisoners, though you can save at least two of them if you object. After Rise at Dawn, you attack Griefberg Castle in Fall Before Dusk, infiltrating through the tunnels below and battling some Kobolds.

The key variations here are that you won't save any of the prisoners, since Brencis knew you were coming. Vlad will also get a load of Manumits killed by rushing the gate if you save him in the intro , and encourage his recklessness in the Old Friends, New Friends quest where you talk to him in the Manumit hideout.
Finally, you'll reach the throne room, where Brencis will try to murder Catalin Dragosti.

After this, you'll continue to the banquet hall, with or without Crake, and will fight Brencis in a room with your family tied to chairs. Unlike the A Lone Wolf's Hunt ending, you can't make a deal with Brencis at this point, since you can't stop Catalin and his army. You'll fight and defeat Brencis, invite him in, or leave him in hell, and the epilogue in Laslea will play.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uHFuXVbY6Q6ErLcNKFpvpH.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/s9NM69NDmrBgYwNpQcXPYH.jpg

This is one of the worst endings in my opinion. Catalin Dragosti undertakes a campaign of retribution against anyone he sees as having helped the Vrakhiri, burning entire districts of Svartrau and filling the castle dungeons. As you see in a note on a tree in Laslea, he also imposes a large tax and encourages people to inform on each other. The epilogue also mentions his mercenary army loots and pillages towns whenever it feels like it.

Perhaps the most heartbreaking part of this ending is it reveals who Crake really is—a toady for Catalin. Under Dragosti's orders, he undertakes a genocide of the Uriashi, seeing them as monsters just like the Vrakhiri. The plague also returns, as does Christianity, but there is a slight silver lining in that this is the only epilogue where you can talk to Crake in Laslea.
Midnight Reckoning
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7aU47sfdvYMgioMhRk38YQ.jpg
Coen helps Lacra end Brencis' sinister scheme.
Meet Lacra during the A Friend Like This quest, which you most likely get via the note on Ambrus's body in The Gilded Gauntlet , and then follow her questline until you unlock Midnight Reckoning.

Alongside Lacra, you enter the Griefberg Castle dungeons via the ancient ruins below and destroy Brencis's ritual, before ascending through the castle to face Brencis himself. The key variables here are that in smashing the ritual, Lacra unleashes hell on the castle. Corpses start coming back to life, huge chunks of the castle are ripped up into the air, and the prisoners lose their minds.
When you finally reach the throne room, your family will be overgrown in the red roots (but still alive). Brencis will appear to confront you and Lacra.

As with the other endings, you'll defeat Brencis in Anachora, and can decide whether to invite him in, or let him be consumed by hell. However, he'll also reveal more in this ending about his plan—that he wanted to accept and harness the curse of Anachora that all vampires harbor instead of trying to resist it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GZXMB3Fi7bQv5STBrwkHWH.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ci7syBKatczZT627s5oNkH.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Jd2Pq2xcMgh7T4iM5ewpgH.jpg

This ending isn't a particularly good one—as with A Lone Wolf's Hunt, Vale Sangora becomes independent for a time, the Manumits defend it, and both Christianity and the plague return. The negative here is basically everyone in the castle dies and it remains a cursed hellscape.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8H2F3G7p2ZVDt9oX4BcuHT.jpg

news.title: 我在 GTA 5 中填满了真实的洛杉矶雪
news.summary: Chestnuts roasting on an open car-fire.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

Okay, two things. First: Los Santos Customs will be taking a hiatus next week, as I spend nine days in a row sleeping and attempting to develop the antibodies to counter whatever exotic German illness it is I acquired at Gamescom 2026 .
Second: it's snowing in Los Santos, just like the real-life LA.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3q5HfnmUhqwkozAxiWaN5h.jpg

I have installed WinterV Beta , with the aim of making Grand Theft Auto 5's weather a little more interesting than it usually is. The pitch is simple: what if there was snow? Well, reader, having played a little GTA 5 with WinterV Beta, I can assure you that there very much is snow. Plus, all the world's lighting takes on a kind of a sickly, ochre hue, which is also just like LA.

From the sky: flurries of flakes. On the roads: cars covered in a sheen of powder, tyre-chains inexplicably equipped (the snow does not, in my version of GTA 5 where a significant chunk of the exterior map has absconded to the phantom zone, settle). In the air: a crisp winter chill. Santa Claus is coming to town; fire a truck at him .

I can't tell you if the presence of snow on the city roads impacts car handling because, as we have established, cars in my GTA 5 no longer have handling . Nevertheless, it does change the vibe quite a lot. As someone who's spent a lot of the last month looking at GTA 5—a change is as good as a rest.
But also, it is time for a rest. I will see you the week after next, whereupon we'll probably finally convert this game into GTA 6. I can feel it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kkNtsnEsZiTdgmuFTn4pJ6.jpg

news.title: 一位受欢迎的主播拒绝了玩《Arc Raiders》的 6 位数交易，因为“这款游戏让我非常沮丧”
news.summary: Seven-figures? Now we're talking.

content.v: Everyone has a price. Maybe it's $100, maybe it's $1,000, maybe it's for someone to see your innate value as a human being, or maybe it's $1,000,000. Popular streamer TimTheTatman recently revealed what it would take to get him to go back to Arc Raiders , and spoilers, it's not the third option.

There was apparently an ad deal floating around for the Arc Raiders and Subway collab, which TimTheTatman was approached for, but did not entertain. "I did say no to six-figures with Arc Raiders, I did," he revealed in a stream earlier this week. "I said 'No thank you'. And it was the Subway Arc Raiders ad. I said I just can't do it, I'm sorry."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nbcyTKP3ArxM2bmu682tgg.jpg

This was met with the exact response you'd expect with people being baffled that he'd ever think of turning down such a lucrative offer. "That's kind of the funny part of being in a streamer position," TimTheTatman continued. "People say 'you're a fucking sellout' but then in the same breath I said I passed on six-figures from Arc Raiders and people are like 'you're fucking stupid'."

He revealed that he does actually have a price to play Arc Raiders again: they'd just have had to add another zero onto the offer. "If that Arc Raiders deal was seven-figures—hey boys welcome back to Arc Raiders and Subway, right, you see what I'm saying? 100% we're going back. But it's just for me, the game frustrated me so much—I got frustrated so much with that game, I just don't want to play it ever again. Even to a point where six-figures isn't going to get me back on it."

I can't say I'm surprised. Arc Raiders is in a bit of a rough spot right now, especially for streamers, what with all the cheating and stream sniping. Embark Studios' executive producer Aleksander Grøndal recently admitted the shortcomings of Arc Raiders and promised that its upcoming major update Frozen Trails will reset the game and provide enough incentive to get players to come back, though—even if they don't get a six-figure deal to do it.

news.title: 《龙与地下城》正在制作一部关于斯特拉德的 Netflix 连续剧，其中涉及《阿兹卡班的囚徒》的导演，老实说，我认为这会很有效
news.summary: I've been hankering after a Curse of Strahd adaptation for a long time.

content.v: Curse of Strahd is one of the most popular D&D modules for a reason—it's actually really compelling. Set in the misty, cursed lands of Barovia, Curse of Strahd is dominated by the titular Strahd von Zarovich, a vampire lord with a tragic backstory and a propensity for showing up at random intervals to give you a fantasy wedgie.
In the one Strahd campaign I played in, my first encounter with the man involved him bleeding our cleric and making my thief drink his blood—so, you know. Normal.

Anyway, per Deadline , we'll be getting a fully-fledged live action Netflix series about him dubbed Ravenloft—after the wider set of domains that darklords like Mr. Zarovich himself enjoy dominion over. It's being helmed by writer and executive producer John August and executive producer Alfonso Cuarón.

The latter of which worked on Harry Potter: The Prisoner of Azkaban. Fittingly, one of the darker Harry Potter films—and owner of exactly the kind of murky, grey aesthetic I'd anticipate in any series taking place in Ravenloft.

The report reads: "Described as a prestige fantasy series where adventure collides with gothic horror and tragic romance, Ravenloft and its Domains of Dread tackle adventure through character-driven stories of dark magic and supernatural intrigue.

"At its heart, the series follows the making of the vampire Darklord Strahd von Zarovich, whose story of power, love, obsession, and undead transformation charts his origins from tragic antihero to one of Dungeons & Dragons’ most notorious villains."

And hey, genuinely? I think this could work out great, assuming it can escape the executive Netflix meddling and second-screen scriptwriting that's been creeping its wormy fingers into games recently. Strahd's entire backstory is tragic enough and appealing enough that unwinding it underpins one of the most popular D&D modules.

I look forward to the season finale where, presumably, a group of four adventurers with increasingly absurd backstories and a sword made out of sunlight punt down his front door and kick his byronic ass.
