news.title: 神谷英树 (Hideki Kamiya) 告诉 Xbox 首席执行官，当她准备好时，他已经准备好制作《Scalebound》
news.summary: Bayonetta creator Hideki Kamiya has a message for Xbox CEO Asha Sharma: When she's ready to make Scalebound, h

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/scalebound-1788539011260.png
Bayonetta creator Hideki Kamiya has a message for Xbox CEO Asha Sharma: When she's ready to make Scalebound , he'll be waiting.

The action-game mastermind and Clovers studio head spoke about his desire to return to his canceled dragon IP during a recent interview with VGC . It's been a little more than nine years since Microsoft finally, officially confirmed it had shut down Scalebound after PlatinumGames announced it in 2014. Still, Kamiya said he's always ready to breathe life back into it.
When asked if he's contacted Sharma about Scalebound, he said, "Well, no, but now’s my opportunity to once again say that if they want to do it, let’s make it happen!"
"[Clovers president Kento Koyama] is on board too," he added. Kamiya then asked the site to include some of what little Scalebound footage was released to the public just so Sharma could take a look.
Kamiya and the rest of PlatinumGames announced the now-canned Xbox One-exclusive action-RPG 12 years ago at E3 2014. A lot has changed since then.

Scalebound eventually returned for gamescom 2015 , one year later, but then mostly went quiet. A delay to 2017 then stoked fears that the project may be in trouble, with a follow-up report then suggesting it could be in trouble before Microsoft delivered the final blow.

Although Kamiya no longer works at PlatinumGames, he confirmed he had moved on to help form Clovers in late 2024 . Although that team is heads down working on Okami 2 , it doesn't mean he isn't hoping to return to Scalebound one day. It's a project he and other PlatinumGames devs have expressed interest in returning to plenty of times over the years. Now, he's hoping Sharma can help make it happen.

During his interview with VGC, Kamiya recalled a recent dinner he had with some of the Scalebound team. He noted the canceled video game wasn't the only thing they talked about, but "it did come up a few times," and they "all remembered how fun it was to work" on it.

"Obviously, there were some tough times as well, but the fact that people still look back on that time with a lot of fun is something that I find very gratifying as the director of the project," Kamiya explained. "Of course, it’s very unfortunate that the project was unable to see the light of day ultimately, and that is something that even now I still very strongly desire to be able to see through if it’s all possible, and I’m being one hundred percent serious when I say that.

Kamiya said Clovers "might not be in a position" to work on Scalebound "right this second," but it's still something he's seeking out. He went as far as to say, "I strongly believe that if you want something strongly enough, you eventually find a way to make it happen."

"That’s the case with Okami right now," he continued, "where even after all these years, the opportunity once again presented itself, and I hope that will be the case with Scalebound in the future as well."

Like Kamiya, Xbox has gone through its own changes recently. Sharma took over for Phil Spencer as CEO in February of this year, leading to a waterfall of snappy changes at Microsoft's gaming wing that have been received both positively and negatively by fans. For example, the company announced last week it would allow players to digitize their physical games . That move in particular seems to have gone over well with fans, but it's done little to cushion the blow that came after Xbox announced it would be laying off 3,200 staff and shedding studios like Double Fine and Ninja Theory in July.
Whether Sharma and the rest of Xbox have room to make Scalebound happen remains to be seen. While we wait to see what the future holds, you can read what Kamiya had to say about the game in 2021 .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

If you've been counting down the days to Onimusha: Way of the Sword , the wait is over. Capcom's latest is out today, and earned an enthusiastic 10/10 review score from us, to boot. For those looking to play on PC, there's even more good news: Fanatical is offering a discount on it right now of 18% off, dropping it down to $57.39 ( see it here ).
Save 18% on Onimusha: Way of the Sword

news.title: 游戏总监终于解决了他传闻中的恋足癖问题——等等，不是小岛，而是另一个
news.summary: A prolific Japanese game developer has finally addressed all that weird foot imagery in his video games. What?

content.v: https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/darksoles.png?w=636

A prolific Japanese game developer has finally addressed all that weird foot imagery in his video games. What? No, I'm not talking about Hideo Kojima (he's busy hanging out with The Backrooms director right now, anyway). I'm referring to Dark Souls and Elden Ring director Hidetaka Miyazaki, who has finally addressed online speculation that he is a foot guy.

“It's not necessarily something I’m consistently aware of--maybe it’s something subconscious coming through,” Miyazaki told The Guardian in response to a question about all the hand imagery in his upcoming action-RPG, The Duskbloods . "Take a look online and there’s a rumor that I have a bit of a thing for feet, but I’m not honestly sure where this comes from."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/MaidenInBlack.png?w=636

Though Miyazaki says he's not sure where the idea that he has a "thing for feet" comes from, it's something fans of his games have noticed for years . Whether we're talking The Maiden in Black from Demons' Souls or Priscilla (or Gwunevere, or Sister Friede, or Maneater Mildred) from Dark Souls, it's hard to ignore how many barefoot women are roaming Miyazaki's fictional worlds. Elden Ring's Malenia is rocking bare feet, too, although hers are metal prosthetics. The game's beaches even differentiate between barefoot players and those who are wearing footwear.
So what's with all the shoeless women in Souls games? According to Miyazaki, it's about depicting the human experience. Or something.
"I feel like I’m trying to depict some side of human nature or the human existence that is difficult to describe,” he elaborated.

But regardless of what fans might think , Miyazaki insists this is not a Tarantino situation. And to be fair, plenty of other games are even more foot-focused than Miyazaki's work--and far less subtle about it.

news.title: 太棒了，由于组件成本增加了 50%，现在主板价格可能会飙升
news.summary: PC gaming sure ain't cheap.

content.v: PC gaming has always been an expensive hobby, but prices have become downright ridiculous as of late. It's bad enough that Nvidia's RTX 50-series cards cost slightly less than an international flight , but the memory supply crisis is also driving up the price of RAM and SSDs . Now it looks like motherboards might be next to see a significant price spike.

Board Channels is a forum for hardware manufacturers and partners to communicate. One poster recently wrote , "The price of upstream raw materials for motherboards has indeed risen significantly." They go on to say that the price of motherboard PCBs alone has increased by between 15% and 50% . Wi-Fi modules are said to have gone up between 10% and 20%, while capacitor prices have also gone up approximately 50% (via Videocardz ).

As we've reported before, these price increases are likely caused by material shortages resulting from the Strait of Hormuz crisis and the ongoing Iran war . For instance, PPE resin can be thought of as the glue that binds the many layers of a PCB together, and a huge chunk of the world's high-quality PPE comes from petrochemical company Saudi Basic Industries Corporation (SABIC) in Saudi Arabia. Not only does this company rely on the Strait of Hormuz to ship exports out, but Reuters reports SABIC's Jubail plant was attacked back in April .

The Board Channels source writes, "The rise in raw material prices for components has at least a 10% impact on the cost of motherboards." Therefore, the prices consumers see will likely have to increase to keep pace—though we've yet to see the peak.

"Looking at the price increases from major motherboard manufacturers in August, the overall increases were relatively small, only around 3%, and affecting a limited number of models," the source continues, "Among Taiwanese brands, MSI raised prices across the board, while Asus and Gigabyte only increased prices for their main models, with small increases ranging from 5-50 yuan. Domestic brands [in China] like Colorful and Maxsun only increased prices by 10-20 yuan, resulting in a relatively small overall increase."

For context, five yuan is about $0.74. 10 yuan is $1.49, and 50 yuan is still only about $7.44 at time of writing. But the source goes on to say, "There is still room for motherboard costs to rise, and it is possible that motherboard manufacturers will continue to raise prices for certain models in the coming months."
In other words, as with so much of hardware pricing right now, it's likely going to get worse before it gets better. Same old story, eh?

news.title: 《寂静岭：小镇陷落》是我玩过的最具苏格兰特色的游戏，也是我多年来见过的最有效的恐怖游戏：“对我们来说，深入挖掘我们的成长经历、我们的过去，并尝试建立一个让人感觉可信的地方是有意义的”
news.summary: And not just because of the foul weather.

content.v: Silent Hill has gone international. Last year we went to Japan in Silent Hill f , and now the series is off to Scotland in Silent Hill: Townfall . As a middle-aged Scot who still remembers the '90s, when Townfall takes place, I was simultaneously nervous and excited about the rare opportunity to play a game that's so close to home.

What a relief, then, that Townfall not only feels incredibly Scottish, its Scottishness also perfectly matches Silent Hill's brand of unsettling psychological horror. And it's not such an unlikely pairing. Scotland is a brilliant fit for this kind of game—and I'm going to spend the next 2,000 or so words convincing you why.

It helps, of course, that the studio is both local and knows its way around the genre. Glaswegian developer Screen Burn has been serving up frights and mysteries since 2015, namely through Stories Untold and Observation . You might know it better by its former name, No Code. Co-founder and Townfall game director Jon McKellan also worked on Alien: Isolation prior to starting up the studio.
Welcome to St. Amelia
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uFra5hsNhshzWC9QpuvAz7.jpg

"We wanted St. Amelia to feel like a real place," McKellan tells me. "And I think, as with most writing, you write what you know, and it made sense for us to dig deep into our upbringings, into our past, and try and build a place that felt believable. To make the player care about this place, you need it to be believable.
We wanted St. Amelia to feel like a real place.
Jon McKellan

Walking the streets of St. Amelia is an eerie experience because it all feels so familiar. There are still so many towns in Scotland that look like this—that mix of old fashioned architecture, cosy little shops and tiny fishing vessels sitting next to modern medical clinics and parked cars. The odd new flourishes squeezing into old spaces.

Outside a shop I notice a pair of charity boxes—one in the shape of a guide dog, another a swirly wishing well that looks like a helter skelter—that nearly everyone from the UK will recognise, not just Scots. These tiny bits of window dressing make the fictional town feel like a tangible place. I have absolutely been here before, even though I definitely haven't.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KY4vdr9XhtLrZPPytpdzyZ.jpg

"A lot of it was going back through our old memories and trying to find things that we remembered, finding old photographs," says McKellan. "But also some genius out there had scanned every Argos catalogue for the last 30 years, and we were like looking at them and finding out, OK, if we need a TV in '90s, let's look at the catalogue from the '90s and find out which one would be more appropriate."
If you want a dose of '90s shopping nostalgia, here's an Argos catalogue from 1990 . Enjoy looking at decades-old lawnmowers and kitchen utensils!

Being set in the '90s also means that technology can't really save you. You don't have a miraculous smart phone in your hands, and satnav was still very new. All you have is your CRTV, a chunky portable TV—just like the one I had as a teen—that picks up fuzzy signals, which you can use to solve puzzles and see where enemies are.

"They're kind of frail, they're unreliable," says McKellan. "I think all of that speaks really well to horror because you get these tools and they help you, but they're never going to be good enough to get you out of a jam. Relying on the analogue, it allows you to play within those limitations, which work well with horror. I think aesthetically as well, it adds texture, even just to the real-world tactile interfaces that feel just a little bit more grounded. Anything we can do to make the player feel like they're there is going to help with horror."
Weather alert
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SwPKh7Ky7m4Nzq76zipLbZ.jpg

It wouldn't be an accurate portrayal of Scotland without our horrible weather, of course, which turns what would otherwise seem like an attractive, inviting town into a dour, dreich place. It's foggy and grey, the Scottish default. Normally, though, that would seem quite welcoming to me. Us Scots are a weird bunch and we're abnormally proud of our shite weather.
It wouldn't be an accurate portrayal of Scotland without our horrible weather.

It's not just because we're pessimists revelling in misery (well, not entirely); there's actually a streak of optimism in the Scottish psyche, with so much Scottish art being about finding beauty in stark, gloomy places. Some of that art is even in my living room, where I've got a trio of prints depicting one of my favourite locations, the gorgeous island of Arran—presented as a jet-black rock—surrounded by a storm.

At a most basic level, it's just nice to be in your cosy home looking out the window at the rain pishing down or the fog rolling in. And Townfall preserves this. While there are plenty of horrors hidden in the buildings, at least in the early part I was playing the streets are a lot more deadly, with the mist hiding horrors drawn from Simon—the protagonist—and St. Amelia's trauma. It feels safer indoors.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hXVbtoJLeDYHziYbkDkRYZ.jpg

When Scotland is presented in videogames, it's usually a brief aside or approaching parody—all kilts and whisky and golf, with accents that call to mind fantasy dwarves. Townfall is more confident in its Scottishness—it doesn't need to scream about it at the top of its lungs. It's an understated familiarity, which lends it a more potent air of authenticity.

In the '90s, most of the world's experience of Scotland came through two movies: Braveheart and Trainspotting. Unsurprisingly, a Hollywood production featuring an Australian nutcase didn't quite capture the country. Trainspotting certainly did, though. It reflected the less palatable side of Scotland, the one the tourists rarely get to see: the squalor, the addiction, the depression and urban decay.

Townfall is much closer to Trainspotting than Braveheart, but rather than urban poverty and heroin addiction, it explores themes like medical trauma, the evisceration of small communities and the social impact of Margaret Thatcher's rule—one of Scotland's most loathed villains, right up there with King Edward I of England, the man also known as the Hammer of the Scots.
Trauma team
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oTNsWasX6gavvDnGLqkveZ.jpg

"The medical trauma is something that Simon's clearly involved with," says McKellan. "Without going into too much detail, I think again you kind of write what you know, and a lot of the experiences that Simon and the characters have have come from a real place and come from something that's pretty authentic in terms of how we cope with those things. So it also felt Silent Hill. It felt like the kind of story you would expect in a series like Silent Hill, without copying anything that's come before."
I think relatability is a big thing in horror.
Jon McKellan

The way this is presented is extremely harrowing. In one early scene, we see a character Simon knows standing in the town square, when a huge tube suspended from the sky appears and plugs into his mouth. There's a hint of cosmic horror in the scene—tentacles coming from the sky—but also grounded psychological horror, that traumatic experience of being hooked up to medical equipment with feeding tubes pumping their contents into your stomach. It's nauseating.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ey6qx98vweU5gXFvEAwBzZ.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cqEcUA8XA9SWrfzyWnKdyZ.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nPVpEFLzwECjVrZ4HPHMaZ.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GTQNCEaPdbv2LWS7upWabZ.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd.jpg

news.title: 回归回合制，旧瓶装新酒：《最终幻想：共鸣》试玩报告
news.summary: 《最终幻想：共鸣》是Square Enix与开发商Lancarse联合推出的《最终幻想》系列最新作，预计于2026年10月22日登陆PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Nintendo Switch、Switch 2

content.v: 《最终幻想：共鸣》是Square Enix与开发商Lancarse联合推出的《最终幻想》系列最新作，预计于2026年10月22日登陆PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Nintendo Switch、Switch 2及PC平台（Steam版10月23日）。
https://image.gcores.com/976c37372b0e2dc8107d7b747013ffaa-3840-2160.png
感谢SE的邀请，我已于前日试玩了本作的部分内容，本次所体验的内容覆盖游戏开篇以及部分强力敌人的挑战。在结束试玩后，我们还有幸采访到了本作的制作人，访谈内容将在之后放出。
SE给这款游戏定下的核心概念是：“如果《最终幻想》在像素风格下持续进化会怎样” —— 而作为系列的第一部“HD-2D”作品， 这个设想在实际体验到游戏之前，我还是觉得多少显得有些冒险。
但实际体验后，游戏在视觉、战斗与叙事层面的综合表现，确实比预想中更加扎实和有趣。
https://image.gcores.com/16c662d42cdbffa9babc291f4193e43f-3840-2160.png
HD-2D的“再进化”
本作的主人公雷因是“格兰谢尔特骑士团”飞空艇部队的队长，与挚友拉斯韦尔共同受命，去调查维系世界平衡的水晶所发生的异变。然而，昔日的战争、操控幻兽的神秘少女、四处破坏水晶的铠甲男，种种线索在调查中逐一浮现。幕后的真相，也随着调查被揭开……
https://image.gcores.com/5181b82b07c83fd0373bd84b2274c5c6-3840-2160.png
从故事框架来看，这似乎是一个典型的《最终幻想》式水晶神话开端，但在实际试玩的时候我发现，它的叙事节奏和章节结构，其实跟传统主机FF略有点不同。
https://image.gcores.com/cf8164500065f1da4c158a42d96584ce-3840-2160.png
仔细想来，这种气质的源头，大概还是在于它的出身——《共鸣》的主线故事是基于2025年结束运营的手游《最终幻想：勇气启示录》（FFBE）第一季剧情，进行彻底重构与改编。原本基于手游的分段式剧情被重新拆解，并且设计成了一条完整的主机RPG故事线。所以从游戏的体验上，把它当作一款全新的像素风《最终幻想》新作似乎也不为过。
不可否认，《共鸣》确实复用了部分FFBE时期遗留的美术素材，但作为系列首款HD-2D作品，这些素材经过了大量的翻新与优化，从视觉感受上来看，它仍然有十足的“新鲜感”。
https://image.gcores.com/c9bdcc6c0970900e16aa46325349b900-3840-2160.png
比如角色的比例部分，与《歧路旅人》等其他的HD-2D作品不同，《共鸣》中角色的头身比得到了扩大。虽说刚开始看上去的时候会觉得有点儿奇怪，但更多的像素，就意味着角色能够展现出更精细的动作细节与表情变化。
在实际战斗中，原本的“像素角色”有着更明确的攻击/受击动作，自然也就有花样更多，战斗起来更丰富的表现力了。
https://image.gcores.com/78f113661ebd771a2215db7c20999836-3840-2160.png
另一个亮点是SE称之为“Cinematic Pixel Art”（电影级像素艺术）的全新表现技法——将3DCG影像像素化处理后用于开场动画和重要剧情过场。这种手法既保留了像素画的质感，又实现了动态运镜的电影化效果。
一开始我对这个技法还没有什么概念，但在看过了开场动画之后，就理解到了它的精妙之处：它并不是单纯的把3DCG转变成像素这么简单，而是有意识地处理3D与像素的边界，让像素重构了3D场景的空间感与纵深感。
https://image.gcores.com/56abe06de317c672554960fcc875a841-3840-2160.png
除了角色的展示以外，游戏中使用的动态镜头之多，也确实是其他HD-2D游戏所未曾使用过的。每一个摄像机角度都进行了逐一调整，并同步对角色像素进行了适配性修正，从而确保视角切换时不会出现怪异的变形等情况。
因此，《共鸣》中频繁出现的大景深特写与大胆的透视角度，赋予了画面远超同类作品的视觉冲击力。
https://image.gcores.com/59bf4bbd95b1aba41fc081caad78fbab-3840-2160.png
总的来说，我觉得这个技法更像是某种“风格化”的处理，它让过场动画不再只限于“像素小人对对碰”的那种表现力，而是可以展现更加宏大的气势，同时又不会与游戏本身的像素美术产生割裂感，让游戏的视觉体验保持了高度的一致性。
https://image.gcores.com/87096f5c75b70bdcc63fa761bab29831-3840-2160.png
回合制的深度
战斗系统是本作试玩的核心体验部分。本作回归了纯粹的回合制指令战斗，放弃了ATB半即时制，屏幕顶部清晰排列敌我双方的行动顺序——从这一设计来看，它在玩法层面还是保留了最纯正的JRPG基因。
https://image.gcores.com/2a40a98174244399ddf5170c38ee2d27-3840-2160.png
不过本作的核心机制则是“破防”机制：每个敌人都拥有独立的破防槽，玩家的每一次攻击，无论是否针对弱点，都会削减该槽，而针对属性弱点的攻击则能造成更大幅度的削减。当破防槽归零时，敌人会陷入无法行动的状态，同时击破该角色的玩家会获得一个额外行动回合。
这一设计很容易让人联想到《歧路旅人》，但在细节上，本作却有一些明确的区分设计：比如普通攻击也能削减敌人的破防槽，所以就不需要在回合初期先尝试找弱点属性；而破防后的额外行动回合，则让队伍的行动排序有了新的可能性。
https://image.gcores.com/0d3daba21ba3493890e97022fdd78c70-3840-2160.png
如果玩家在一回合内使所有敌人都进入破防状态，即可发动名为“共鸣”的强力必杀技，从已装备的“幻兵”中选择其一释放，伴随一段精美的3D CG动画，这些“幻兵”们用各种花里胡哨的必杀技，打出爆炸的伤害数字……其实CG动画是从手游里面直接拿过来的，不过做了一下宽屏处理。
https://image.gcores.com/50e5f9dc1bed7b4b3edbec05a8d11c8b-3840-2160.png
如果说破防和共鸣是战斗系统的“骨架”，那么“幻兵”系统就是赋予这款游戏《最终幻想》灵魂的关键。简单来说，“幻兵”其实就是原本FFBE抽卡的核心元素，但在《共鸣》中，则改成了“幻兵水晶”，需要玩家在冒险途中探访分布于世界各地的“光之祠”才能获得。在试玩版中，提供了光之战士、洋葱剑士、蒂娜、克劳德、香托托、雷霆、诺克提斯等经典角色。
每名队伍成员可以装备一个幻兵，在战斗中每个回合都可以从我方角色或其装备的幻兵之间选择其一进行行动——相当于角色多了一套新的技能。不过从视觉层面来看，幻兵的存在更像是《JOJO奇妙冒险》中的“替身”。
这些幻兵有职业的区分，分别是“攻击者“”破坏者”“阻碍者”“治疗者”“防御者”，这个设计跟《最终幻想13》微妙的有些相似。调整幻兵的属性，也就等同于调整角色的定位。不同的职业定位对敌人弱点具有更强的针对性。随着战斗进行，角色与幻兵之间的羁绊会逐渐加深，习得新的能力和技能，只不过试玩时间有限，我并没有更深入地体验到这些幻兵的搭配乐趣。
此外，积累极限槽后还可发动各角色特有的“极限爆发”必杀技。不同角色的必杀技拥有各自独立的镜头设计、特效与攻击表现，更重要的是，其效果特性也各不相同——有的对破防状态下的敌人造成额外伤害，有的附带属性攻击，有的则强化暴击威力。这些差异化的设计使得极限爆发同样具备了扭转战局的能力。
综合来看，《共鸣》的战斗系统在经典回合制框架下构建了一套层次分明的攻防循环。破防，共鸣与幻兵这三个系统层层递进，形成了“积累—输出—爆发”的闭环。 在普通难度下，《共鸣》的战斗既保留了JRPG回合制经典的沉稳感，又通过多重机制的嵌套，营造出充足的变化空间。
整体而言，本作的战斗系统算是这次试玩中给我留下的，最为扎实的印象部分。
结语
总的来说，《最终幻想：共鸣》让我觉得有些“意外”：虽然它植根于FFBE，却又做出了超出手游框架的，JRPG的那种本格的乐趣。而在视觉层面，它也确实把HD-2D推到了一个此前连“像素大师合集”都没达到的新高度。
当然，试玩版也留下了一些悬念：26种幻兵在正式版中的搭配深度究竟如何？主线故事的叙事质量能否维持系列一贯的水准？ 这些问题需要在正式版中才能得到完整答案。
但对于喜欢HD-2D风格或怀念经典回合制《最终幻想》的玩家来说，10月22日正式发售的《最终幻想：共鸣》的试玩Demo现已上线各个平台，存档可继承至正式版，感兴趣的话不妨下载一试。

news.title: 30 款你需要玩的开放世界杰作 - IGN30
news.summary: From web-swinging superheroes and sword-swinging monster hunters to bank heists and shrine raids, these are th

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/02/openworld-blog-1788348435810.jpg

Open-world games. Arguably, no other genre has defined modern gaming more than the expansive, experimental, and exciting places this one has taken us to. Over the past 30 years, we’ve gone from grey, empty streets begging to be torn up in a blocky muscle car to glorious, colourful fantasy lands full of adventure and opportunity. But what are the games that have stood out the most, pushed the form forward, and ultimately led to GTA 6’s moment?

As part of IGN 30, I’m going to try to answer that question by walking you through five distinct flavours of open-world game before deciding on the greatest of them all. From web-swinging superheroes and sword-swinging monster hunters to bank heists and shrine raids, here are the 30 masterpieces of open-world game design.
City Living

GTA. There are really no other three letters to start with than Rockstar’s industry-changing creation, especially when it comes to city settings. What started as a top-down, level-based car-stealing simulation in 1997 was fun, but limited by the confines of the technology of the time. It would take another four years, and the creation of the PS2 and its DVD storage capabilities, for the series to truly become a phenomenon as it stepped into the 3D era with Grand Theft Auto 3.
Grand Theft Auto 3
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/20/gta-3-1787216107651.jpg

Claude’s violent journey through the streets of Liberty City set the template for the next 10 years of copycats — a few of which we’ll look at in a short while. It took a setting first sketched out in the original GTA and combined it with the sort of cinematic storytelling emerging on PlayStation at the time to perform alchemy. The result was a first of its kind and a new gold standard for open worlds.

They may feel like monotonous, clunky missions to play through now, but there’s no denying the permanent blueprint GTA 3 created for expansive city games to come, nor the way it managed to successfully weave a story that evoked prestige television into an open world structure — casting multiple Sopranos alumni in the process. It took the pulsating urban driving experience pioneered in Driver, a 1999 open-zone car chaser, and presented it in a wholly new way. Sure, there were open-world city games before GTA 3, but not many others on this list would exist without it.

After what seems an impossibly short development timeline to comprehend these days, just one year later, those grey, rainy streets would be swapped out for the neon blues and pastel pinks of GTA: Vice City . Again, a huge step up for the series.
Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/20/vice-city-1787216147970.jpg

Tommy Vercetti’s tale offered virtual time travel back to an exaggerated 1980s that felt like a love fist to the face back in 2002. GTA 3’s city served its street-level crime story perfectly, but Vice City created a sandbox you wanted to spend time in, regardless of plot momentum. Yes, its hit-filled radio stations played a huge part in creating its vibe, but so did its numerous landmarks and distinct gang-controlled regions that made this slice of fictional Florida feel alive.

It felt more like existing in a world, and gave you the opportunity to soak in its culture in a way GTA 3 never did — managing to still provide a propulsive story, but allowing more time to breathe in between missions. In this respect, it borrowed aspects from an even earlier open-world game: Shenmue.
Shenmue
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/20/shenmue-1787216202382.jpg

Yu Suzuki’s Dreamcast tale of a martial artist seeking revenge for the murder of his father in 1980s Japan immersed the player in an unparalleled level of world-building for the time — dressing its environments in impressive detail, while also encouraging you to simply exist in its world. Its influence can be seen in many an open-world game, including GTA, but perhaps most prominently in the Yakuza series, where minigames, colourful characters and eccentric slices of life can be found on every one of its Japanese and, now, Hawaiian street corners.

A day/night system and variable weather conditions went a long way to making 1986 Yokosuka feel like a lived-in city, setting a new precedent when it came to existing in a persistent world full of NPCs living their life around you. Shenmue’s raft of minigames, including throwing darts and forklift racing, undoubtedly influenced GTA, and ultimately could be considered to blame for Niko Bellic’s cousin barraging your phone with bowling invitations a decade later in an HD universe Liberty City.

But back in 2002, after Vice City, GTA would take two years to return with the just-as-brilliant San Andreas. Naturally, other studios were already trying to piggyback on its success in the meantime. Chief among those were The Getaway and Mafia. Both had their moments, but felt like first drafts for something more promising. Unfortunately, the former London-set Guy Ritchie pastiche would fail to live up to that promise when the disappointing The Getaway: Black Monday arrived in 2004. But developer 2K Czech took its time with the Mafia series, and it proved worth the wait when a sequel released in 2010 .
Mafia 2
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/20/mafia-2-1787216230869.jpg

Undoubtedly influenced by GTA 4, which dropped two years prior and tackled the notion of the American dream through the eyes of an immigrant, this post-war tale of organised crime told its story brilliantly, even if it was lacking as a sandbox compared to Rockstar’s creations. Heavily inspired by Francis Ford Coppola’s The Godfather films, it was another step forward in open-world cities as digital tourism, recreating 1940s and 50s USA to great detail, placing the time period and societal tensions front of mind. It’s a mindset that was also taken into its sequel, Mafia 3, a flawed but fascinating examination of Vietnam War-era America, race, and political corruption.

This was a more serious era for the open-world game, with Rockstar even letting sincerity seep into GTA 4 and Red Dead Redemption. Both games were tales of one man’s tussle with a changing America and a haunted past. And though each still packed its fair share of silliness, they took swipes at capitalism through satire too. That maturity was offset by the Saints Row series, which took the bullshit by the horns and ran with it, peaking in 2011 with Saints Row: The Third .
Saints Row: The Third
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/20/saints-row-third-1787216254766.jpg

A city where the sight of a weaponised dildo was as commonplace as a flying motorcycle, Steelport turned its gaze away from real-world issues and instead treated its world like an amusement park. An exercise in audacity, it pushed the GTA formula to comic extremes and feels more like a relic of a different era than perhaps any other open-world game on this list. In some ways, the series shared more with the superhero genre — of which we’ll delve more into very soon — than it did with Rockstar’s open worlds by the time Saints Row: The Third came about, giving players the freedom to live out their wildest power trip fantasies, no matter how puerile they may have been.

More considered contenders for the GTA-alike crown would come and go. Sleeping Dogs garnered a cult following thanks to its Hong Kong-set martial arts action. The original Watch Dogs may have failed to live up to high expectations, but its San Francisco-set sequel hit the mark thanks to its vibrant Bay Area setting and eclectic cast of hackers. But, in reality, they were just warming the seat for the king. It may come as no surprise that my pick for the best city-based open-world game is GTA 5, still unbeaten some 13 years later.

news.title: 在电影和电视剧里讲游戏故事，这家公司是专业的

content.v: “这项工作确实变得比以前更容易了，却也不像一些人想象中那么容易。”影视制片公司Story Kitchen联合创始人德米特里·约翰逊（Dmitri Johnson）说。按照约翰逊和另一位联合创始人迈克·戈德堡（Mike Goldberg）的说法，虽然近年来有一大批改编自热门游戏的影视剧在票房和口碑层面获得成功，但当他俩试图向其他制片厂的高层推销基于游戏IP的影视项目时，整个过程仍然充满挑战。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/5356a840d32c088d.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“我们每天都在努力改变人们对游戏的刻板印象：很多人始终认为，电子游戏只适合小孩子，以及那些无所事事，成天窝在家里的宅男。”约翰逊苦笑着补充，“但事实上，游戏开发者也是艺术家和讲述故事的人，他们的作品值得被更多人看到。”
■ 开始游戏
你很可能不太了解Story Kitchen，但肯定听说过这家公司曾参与制作的游戏改编影视作品，例如派拉蒙影业发行的“刺猬索尼克”系列电影、Netflix的“古墓丽影”动画剧，以及将在亚马逊流媒体平台Prime Video播出的《奇异人生》《古墓丽影》真人剧集。某种意义而言，Story Kitchen正站在游戏衍生影视作品“黄金时代”的最前沿。

上世纪90年代到本世纪初，大量游戏改编电影因质量糟糕饱受诟病，包括《超级马力欧兄弟》（1993年上映）、《毁灭战士》（2005年）和《死亡之屋》（2003年）等，其中，《死亡之屋》更沦为了知名影评网站烂番茄历史评分最低的影片之一。戈德堡指出，那些古早游戏改编电影之所以纷纷遭遇失败，很大程度上是因为众多娱乐巨头未能充分理解原作。“如今回头来看，这确实有点像电子游戏改编作品遭到的一种诅咒。”戈德堡说，“在那个年代，好莱坞制片公司普遍对游戏玩家、开发商和发行商缺乏尊重，电子游戏似乎注定会被边缘化，永远无法走到视觉媒体领域的舞台中央。”
2011年，德米特里·约翰逊和丹·杰文斯（Dan Jevons）联合创办dj2娱乐公司（Story Kitchen的前身——译注），迈出了探索未知领域的第一步。Dj2的主要目标很简单，那就是向好莱坞公司展示游戏故事的潜力，并说服他们投入资金，打造基于游戏IP的影视作品。然而，由于好莱坞大厂并不看好这门生意的前景，Dj2曾经屡屡碰壁，遭到了无数次拒绝。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/2516a840ef43385b.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

首部《刺猬索尼克》真人电影成了Dj2发展历程中的转折点。经过长期沟通，约翰逊一步步赢得了日本游戏发行商世嘉的信任和尊重，使世嘉和派拉蒙影业公司相信，人们渴望看到蓝色刺猬索尼克在一部属于自己的电影中亮相。《刺猬索尼克》在制作期间遭遇了一些挫折，比如当首支预告片发布后，索尼克的形象引起众多玩家抨击，制作团队不得不迅速重新设计……不过2020年初，尽管疫情导致《刺猬索尼克》的院线放映提前结束，这部电影仍然斩获3.2亿美元的全球票房，票房收入远远超过了制作和营销成本（约9000万美元）。
“约翰逊始终相信，只要制片公司真正理解并尊重游戏IP，就能够打造出成功的游戏改编作品。”戈德堡指出，“事实证明他是对的。”
■ 精挑细选
自从《刺猬索尼克》上映以来，游戏改编热潮的兴起促使影视行业发生了翻天覆地的变化，戈德堡将这些变化描述为“好莱坞生态系统的一次彻底变革”。过去几年间，改编自《超级马力欧兄弟》《我的世界》等热门游戏IP的电影在全球拿下数十亿美元票房，《最后生还者》《辐射》电视剧和游戏衍生动画剧集《英雄联盟：双城之战》等作品也广受好评，斩获多项大奖，并向数百万观众呈现了他们以前从未接触过的故事、角色和世界。

随着游戏改编作品迎来爆发式增长，dj2一直在积累经验，提升自身实力。2022年10月，dj2宣布品牌升级，将团队和项目转移到新成立的影视制作公司Story Kitchen。从那以后，Story Kitchen招募了伊莲娜·桑多瓦尔（Elena Sandoval）、蒂莫西·I·史蒂文森（Timothy I. Stevenson）和达拉斯·狄金森（Dalls Dickinson）等业内资深人士担任高管，还先后在2022年2月和2024年5月，与亚马逊和梦工厂动画公司签署了优先合作协议。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/9696a84108d7f6e6.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

Story Kitchen致力于打造以游戏IP为根基的爆款跨媒介作品。在现阶段，Story Kitchen总部手握大约30个项目，并已经为部分项目找到买家，正在四处推销其他项目。这个数字听起来似乎很夸张，在电子游戏的汪洋里却犹如沧海一粟……那么，Story Kitchen为什么不直接带着一份写满游戏名称的清单去拜访电影制片厂、电视台和流媒体平台，以这种遍地撒网的方式谈合作呢？毕竟，从理论上讲，总有一款游戏能引起影视公司的兴趣。
“我们正处于一个新时代，但并非所有游戏都适合被改编。”戈德堡指出，“无论如何，Story Kitchen渴望长期深耕这一领域，因为我们坚信，游戏改编的热潮绝非昙花一现，而是拥有长远潜力。”
除了3A大作之外，Story Kitchen还长期对2A游戏和独立游戏保持关注。“当我们向潜在合作方推荐IP时，根本不想谈论‘这款游戏卖了多少份？’之类的问题。”约翰逊透露，“事实上，我们鄙视那个问题，往往拒绝回答。在与潜在合作方的沟通中，我们更倾向于解释为什么游戏里的故事和角色精彩绝伦，或者它具备哪些人们从未见过的亮点。”
“归根结底，我们只会挑选能够让我们产生浓厚兴趣，并倾注热情的游戏。一旦我们心里有了目标，觉得必须将某个游戏IP改编成影视作品，就会向其他公司卖力推荐……起初，对方未必理解我们的想法，但仍然想听听我们的方案，因为我们表现出了强烈的热情。当我们带着项目提案上门拜访时，大多数电视台和制片厂的高层都很乐意与我们聊聊。他们非常清楚，我们并非为了捞钱与他们谈合作，而是真心希望打造出高质量的游戏改编作品。”
■ 蓄势待发
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/6266a8410abd1869.png?imageView2/2/w/700
约翰逊和戈德堡总是认真对待Story Kitchen参与制作的每一部游戏改编作品。截至目前，“刺猬索尼克”系列已经推出三部高票房电影和衍生真人剧集《纳克鲁斯》（Knuckles），《刺猬索尼克4》则已进入后期制作阶段，将于2027年3月19日在北美上映。另外，一部据传以暗影（Shadow）为主角、暂未定名的衍生电影也在制作中，但约翰逊和戈德堡拒绝透露细节。“我们必须遵守保密协议。”戈德堡说。
2027年，Story Kitchen参与制作的两部电视剧将会在亚马逊流媒体平台Prime Video播出，其中之一是经典动作冒险游戏《古墓丽影》的真人剧集。菲比·沃勒-布里奇担任该剧的编剧兼执行制作人，苏菲·特纳将饰演主角劳拉·克劳馥。
按照约翰逊的说法，在Netflix动画剧集《古墓丽影》制作期间，Story Kitchen与游戏工作室水晶动力（Crystal Dynamics）建立了良好的合作关系。“作为合作伙伴，我们希望在未来再次携手，并为此制定了非常清晰的计划。”因此，当亚马逊提议为《古墓丽影》制作真人剧集时，Story Kitchen和水晶动力似乎迎来了一次千载难逢的机会。
“剧组的每个决定都需要经过水晶动力批准。”约翰逊透露，“《古墓丽影》第一季得到了水晶动力的认可，他们积极参与其中，同时非常尊重《古墓丽影》铁杆玩家菲比的想法……事实上，前段时间我们已经开始观看《古墓丽影》真人剧的初剪版，全程都像10岁小孩那样笑个不停。我对这部剧的质量很有信心。”
“顺便提一句，我们不是那种喜欢自吹自擂的人。如果你妈妈观看《古墓丽影》真人剧，她不会觉得这部剧改编自一个拥有30年历史的电子游戏系列。我们不想将《古墓丽影》改编成一部只面向核心玩家的粉丝向作品。当然，我们尊重玩家，会努力让玩家感受到被重视，但我们的目标是让那些从未玩过《古墓丽影》游戏的新观众，也像我们一样爱上这部剧。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/3786a8410f8c86d9.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

《奇异人生》是另一部将于2027年登陆Prime Video平台的新剧，作为联合制片方，Story Kitchen遇到了与制作《古墓丽影》完全不同的挑战。《奇异人生》真人剧改编自2015年问世的同名冒险游戏，后者采用章节体结构，讲述了一位拥有“时间倒流”能力的高中生麦克斯的故事。游戏原作以基于对话选项的分支叙事闻名，不过，玩家所做的选择最终只会导向两个结局中的一个。在项目筹备和剧本创作阶段，Story Kitchen怎样改编原作中基于玩家选择、不断演变的故事？他们又如何决定采用哪个结局？毕竟，“奇异人生”系列未来还会推出新作，讲述麦克斯的全新故事，而一些观众可能将电视剧结局当成真正的官方结局。
“在《奇异人生》游戏中，几乎所有重大决定都令玩家左右为难，选择不同选项的玩家可能各占一半。”约翰逊指出，“我们从一开始就很清楚，任何结局都不可能令所有人满意。话虽如此，我认为许多观众会为我们对游戏里某些关键决策的处理方式感到高兴，甚至很可能被电视剧的结局所感动。”
与此同时，Story Kitchen和亚马逊米高梅影业正在全力推进瑞典工作室Hazelight旗下两款高口碑游戏的电影改编项目，分别是《双人成行》和《双影奇境》。其中，《双影奇境》真人电影仍处于早期开发阶段，不过戈德堡证实，知名演员西德妮·斯威尼、“魔法坏女巫”系列电影的导演朱浩伟、《死侍》编剧雷特·里斯和保罗·韦尼克参与了该项目。
“你可以和伴侣、朋友或家人一起玩游戏，每个人能从中获得自己的体验。”戈德堡说，“我们如何诠释这些体验，并将它们转变成观众共同的感受？这本身就是一项充满乐趣的挑战。作为电影编剧，里斯和韦尼克甚至坚持亲自玩一玩《双影奇境》，而这肯定会对他们创作的剧本产生影响。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/5216a84120c22558.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
与《双影奇境》真人电影相比，Hazelight工作室另一款游戏《双人成行》改编电影的制作进度缓慢得多。早在2022年，巨石强森的Seven Bucks制片公司就宣布加入这个由亚马逊主导的项目，然而，Hazelight创意总监约瑟夫·法尔斯在去年2月接受媒体采访时透露，他对《双人成行》电影改编项目的状况几乎一无所知。
“好莱坞的繁琐流程太多，有些事情看似板上钉钉，其实八字都没一撇。”法尔斯直言，“我觉得在好莱坞，90%的会议都是扯淡……很多时候，参与谈判的各方光说不练，没有把计划落到实处。我不知道到底发生了什么，但愿能看到成果吧。如果《双人成行》电影能够与观众们见面，那当然很好，不过我不抱太大希望。”
当被问到法尔斯、Hazelight和巨石强森是否仍然参与《双人成行》影视剧项目时，约翰逊表示：“是的。如今我们与Hazelight团队关系密切，彼此间形成了一种默契。我们和Hazelight以及其他合作伙伴的沟通都非常顺畅。”
■ 枝繁叶茂
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/7186a8412312a71b.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

这只是Story Kitchen计划推进的30多个影视项目中的冰山一角。按照约翰逊和戈德堡的说法，Story Kitchen希望覆盖尽可能多的游戏类型和受众群体。目前，这家公司正在筹备3款Roblox游戏《种植花园》《Steal a Brainrot》和《Jailbreak》的电影改编项目，并与环球影业合作，为《正当防卫》《忍》和《Ruiner》制作真人电影。除此之外，Story Kitchen参与制片的其他游戏改编影视作品还包括《师父》《Kingsmaker》《怒之铁拳》《渔帆暗涌》和《死亡之屋》真人电影等。

Story Kitchen的业务并不局限于将游戏改编为电影。过去两年间，Story Kitchen还在制作一部《玩具反斗城》真人电影，以及一部以会说话的玩具熊特迪·华斯比（Teddy Puxpin）为主角的电影。“我觉得它跟《芭比》（2023年上映）有点像。”约翰逊说，“我一开始的想法是‘哎，又有人想圈钱了’，但当看到第三幕时，我竟然有点想哭……这部电影的搞笑程度可能超出人们的想象。我们加入了一些看似荒诞的歌舞元素，并以一种绝妙的方式将它们与剧情完美融合。总之，我相信它会让观众感到惊喜，孩子们看完电影后肯定想要一只特迪·华斯比玩具熊。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/8686a841259123da.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

就游戏改编项目而言，Story Kitchen 不仅仅将经典旧作和当下热门游戏视为潜在的改编对象，还会关注一些仍处于开发阶段的新游戏。“我们正在为一款尚未公布的游戏筹备剧集，并即将向潜在合作方介绍相关方案。”戈德堡透露，“如果一切顺利，开发商将会在2026年TGA颁奖典礼期间正式公布这款游戏。不过，我们下个月就会带着一份制作精美，包含完整剧本的电视剧提案拜访各大制片厂，以便在游戏官宣后迅速推进项目。”
约翰森补充，早在《光与影：33号远征队》发售前，Story Kitchen就与这款回合制角色扮演游戏的法国研发工作室Sandafall达成了合作。“Story Kitchen从不追逐热度，我们为此感到自豪。”约翰逊说，“一旦某款游戏成为热门大作，我们追求它的动力就会下降，因为我们不想被人们视为一家盲目跟风的公司。”

“事实上，我们从2023年就开始与Sandfall合作了。我们阅读了近600页剧本，听原始的音乐文件，还欣赏了大量美术设计，在看到游戏的任何实机画面前就深深爱上了它……当然，谁都无法预知一款游戏的销量，所以我们早就知道，如果《光与影：33号远征队》卖得不好，我们将很难向其他制片公司推销我们制定的电影改编计划。但正如我之前所说，一旦我们对某个项目燃起热情，就不会轻易接受‘不’。我们始终相信，这是一个值得我们投入的项目。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-18/5506a84129dca00f.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
尽管Story Kitchen已经手握30多个项目，约翰逊和戈德堡仍然渴望将更多经典IP改编成影视作品。约翰逊透露，他梦想着将“洛克人”和“龙行忍者”（Bad Dudes）搬上大荧幕，戈德堡最念念不忘的IP则是任天堂的经典科幻游戏系列“密特罗德”（Metroid）。
某种意义而言，在约翰逊和戈德堡的领导下，Story Kitchen正在重塑跨媒体娱乐领域。

“前不久，我们回顾了去年英国电影与电视艺术学院游戏奖（BAFTA Game Awards）的候选游戏名单，其中包含由一支澳大利亚小团队开发的点击冒险游戏《漂泊者》（The Dirfter）。”约翰逊回忆，“作为BAFTA的评委，自从2025年偶然发现《漂泊者》以来，我一直对它赞不绝口。经过一番努力，我们与《漂泊者》的开发团队建立联系，并在与另一家制片公司的首次谈判中就达成合作意向，对方同意将这款游戏改编成一部真人电影。”

“如果时间回到五六年前，这一切根本不可能发生。如今，Story Kitchen已经走完第一步，打破了‘游戏改编作品被诅咒’这种愚蠢观念。接下来我们将会迈出第二步，那就是郑重其事地告诉大家，游戏改编的影视作品有能力赢得奥斯卡、艾美奖和英国电影学院奖等权威奖项。这是我们的下一个目标：证明电子游戏也是艺术。我们将会努力让人们看到，电子游戏讲述的故事、塑造的角色……都与在《纽约时报》榜单中排名前列的畅销书并无二致。”
本文编译自： techradar

原文标题：《'That's our next mission — proving that games are art': meet Story Kitchen, the bold, trail-blazing studio behind the popular Sonic movies that wants to turn your favorite game into the next movie or TV hit》
原作者：Tom Power

news.title: 触乐怪话：播客初体验
news.summary: 触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。 原来这就是云里雾里！图/小罗 前段时间，我和朋友聊起：我想拥有一点活人感，还想增加一些生活趣味，有什么法子？他说，不如来录期播客吧。 我对这个提议有些惊喜，也有些犹豫。

content.v: http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-04/6a9a7b2642e62.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。
前段时间，我和朋友聊起：我想拥有一点活人感，还想增加一些生活趣味，有什么法子？他说，不如来录期播客吧。
我对这个提议有些惊喜，也有些犹豫。毕竟，从学生时代起，脱稿讲话必定是我的噩梦。和朋友闲聊可以，我愿意把故事讲得有趣一些，将那些曲折的部分描述得尽量离奇，甚至加上夸张的表情和动作。这样效果总不会太差。但是，要让人正襟危坐讲些什么，比如打辩论、上台讲正课PPT，我总觉得思维在天空飞，也不知道如何让它们变得有趣。
所以，其实我挺担心自己在播客里会无话可讲。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-04/7746a9a7a869bb24.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
但我同时又有些兴奋。毕竟这可是我的播客初体验，还能写一篇夜话呢。
于是，我参加了这期播客，和朋友一起聊聊音游。怎么说呢，全程我的角色有些错位，我总想问问题，挑起话头。我最快乐的时候，是问问题，其次是用开玩笑的方式挑衅熟人。有冲突，就会有趣。但要让我说话，我会说些看起来非常深奥的话。总之就是一点都不好笑。
我发誓，我其实有提前准备。在开聊前，我围绕“从《节奏天国：奇迹之星》出发聊聊音游”这个话题准备了一些问题，也提前准备了一些回答。这个过程很有趣，能够帮助自己思考和整理思路，但坏就坏在我准备了不少延伸问题，关于《节奏天国：节奏之星》的回答，我还没来得及思考，播客就开始了。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-04/8376a9a7aa89fb08.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在开头，我在情绪激昂地介绍了自己的网名后，非常认真地说：“《节奏天国》是最有趣的音游。”朋友找到了机会：“你说是‘最有趣’。这是为什么呢？”这个问题我没准备过……于是我语气弱弱地说：“因为它很无厘头呀，你还能给洋葱拔胡子呢，太有趣了。”我感受到一种不太兴奋的氛围，这时有人帮我重复了一句：“对，很无厘头。”
我始终觉得这句话太过贫瘠，完全没有描述出《节奏天国》到底有多有趣。这可是一款可以给洋葱拔胡子的游戏呀。玩家还可以当青蛙伴舞，跳错了，就会看见一同伴舞的青蛙忧伤地看着你，而自己流着汗，显得非常窝囊，然后，我就会莫名其妙地觉得很好笑。笑够了，下一把再继续努力。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-04/9836a9a7a9cbd2b6.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
总之，我当时开了一个相当平凡的开头。后面开始问问题时，我倒有些自在。但是，又和我的朋友开始打架，因为这期播客主要由他主导节奏。
我中间开始思考播客这种形式，它似乎和采访有些相似，两人之间一问一答。但它其实更像那种对谈，双方有来有回地交流。当现场有三个人时，或许由一个人主导提问比较好。但三个人的回答汇聚在一起，又会碰撞出一些有趣的观点。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-04/7226a9a7abab72d9.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
一小时很快过去，按下结束录制的键后，我松了一口气。我们反而聊起了更多平和有趣的内容。
对了，最后收尾的问题，我也回答得异常尴尬，有种高中生写论文强行升华的语调。（其实今天中午听了一遍，没有我想得那么坏。）
总之，这是一次有趣的经历。但你要想让我指路，那我只能说这是秘密。因为现在回想起来，心里的感受就是，好好笑。算了，下一把再努力。（以及没有吃到凉拌菠萝，但吃到了烤菠萝）

news.title: 生软班底新作能和章鱼恋爱交配？官方回应尺度有多大
news.summary: 《大迁离》（Exodus）由Archetype Entertainment开发，该工作室的多位核心创始成员都曾是BioWare的资深开发者，而本作也被不少玩家…

content.v: 《大迁离》（Exodus）由Archetype Entertainment开发，该工作室的多位核心创始成员都曾是BioWare的资深开发者，而本作也被不少玩家视为《质量效应》系列的精神续作。
近日，IGN在Gamescom期间采访了《大迁离》游戏总监Chris King、叙事总监Drew Karpyshyn以及总经理Chad Robertson，并重点询问了游戏中的恋爱玩法。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/04/small_202609042304533132.png
作为《质量效应》的粉丝，IGN记者首先问了一个颇为特别的问题：玩家能不能与游戏中的“章鱼”角色Salt发展恋爱关系，甚至发生性关系？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/04/small_202609042304554451.png
Salt是一名“觉醒者”章鱼，驾驶着专门设计的战斗机甲，并能够释放类似墨汁的烟幕干扰敌人。她平时生活在维持生命的水箱中，并可以在战场上操控机甲作战。
对此，叙事总监Drew Karpyshyn确认，Salt无法成为恋爱对象。他解释称：“很遗憾，Salt没有恋爱路线。主要是因为Salt觉得人类很恶心。我们只有四肢，她会觉得‘这很奇怪！’”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/04/small_202609042305356615.jpg
虽然玩家无法与Salt发展恋爱关系，但《大迁离》依然会提供多名可攻略角色，而且恋爱关系不会受到玩家性别的限制。不过，玩家需要主动推动恋爱关系，并不会因为某些选择意外进入恋爱路线。
同时，玩家的感情选择还可能影响队友之间的关系，甚至引发冲突。
由于《大迁离》是一款M级游戏，一些玩家可能会认为其中的性场景会比较大胆。不过，开发团队表示，游戏中的相关内容会采取相对克制的表现方式。对于具体尺度，Karpyshyn表示：“整个行业对于这类内容都有不同的标准，我认为我们处于一个比较合适的中间位置。”
IGN随后将《大迁离》与其他作品进行了比较。例如，《博德之门3》的亲密场景包含裸露内容；《赛博朋克2077》在这方面则更加大胆。相比之下，《质量效应》系列中的相关场景十分简短，也不会进行露骨展示。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/04/small_202609042305456044.png
《大迁离》预计于2027年4月7日登陆PC、PS5以及Xbox Series X|S。

news.title: Xbox 与 TCL 的新合作来得正是时候
news.summary: Xbox has announced a new partnership with TCL, which will see the Xbox app added to "select" models from the b

content.v: Xbox has announced a new partnership with TCL, which will see the Xbox app added to "select" models from the brand. This means that owners of those TCL TVs won't need to spend $500 on an Xbox Series S or $800 on an Xbox Series X, as they can instead take advantage of the cloud-based gaming features offered as part of a monthly Xbox Game Pass subscription-- but only for a few hours per month , before they need to start coughing up some extra cash to buy more hours to play.

This announcement also comes during a busy time for Xbox, as its next big first-party game is Gears of War: E-Day. It arrives after a busy year for the gaming brand, which saw 75 day-one releases through its subscription program. More Game Pass titles are also on the way in Septembe r, with Speedrunners 2 and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War headlining the first wave of new arrivals.

TCL TVs are typically positioned as budget-to-mid-range sets, which could potentially give Xbox exposure to millions of consumers who wouldn't normally buy one of their expensive consoles. The Azure servers that Xbox uses for streaming games belong to its parent company, Microsoft, and these have started to turn a tidy profit for the company. Microsoft recently reported $29.4 billion in Azure server sales for the last quarter, but Amazon Web Services still eclipses those numbers with $42.2 billion in quarterly revenue.

news.title: 怎么DLSS 5突然变成热门民间活动了？
news.summary: 一项前沿技术如何彻底调动起了群众的积极性。 前几天的德国科隆游戏展期间，我去NVIDIA的展台用顶配PC，体验了DLSS 5在内的多项NVIDIA最新游戏图形技术。 类似的活动，今年GDC期间我也参与过一次。时隔半年，除

content.v: 一项前沿技术如何彻底调动起了群众的积极性。
前几天的德国科隆游戏展期间，我去NVIDIA的展台用顶配PC，体验了DLSS 5在内的多项NVIDIA最新游戏图形技术。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/64d357497b4604c49dfd46bc7292626d.appmsg_mw680water

类似的活动，今年GDC期间我也参与过一次。时隔半年，除了DLSS 4.5光线重建和路径追踪这些成熟强项，能感觉到的是，软硬件迭代的速度依然很快。比如这次演示多了搭载了RTX Spark芯片的笔记本电脑，虽然是ARM架构，但对游戏的兼容性不差。看着现场多台设备以轻薄、低功耗的身躯，流畅运行《007 初露锋芒》《无主之地4》《ARC Raiders》等3A大作，我摸了摸机器感觉也不太烫，情不自禁就想拥有一台。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/50f9a272361c70e01790251afb4aa9de.appmsg_mw680water
ACE作为NVIDIA主推的本地生成式 AI 驱动的数字人服务，也有了更适合与玩法结合的落地场景。在《伊莫》中，玩家无需操作传统菜单，可通过自然语言与伊莫进行互动和聊天，使其学习技能，采集资源等等。以往ACE的演示较多集中在“对话”的形式上，这次和游戏的基础玩法机制绑定后，给人感觉更实用了，这项技术将在2027年初实装在《伊莫》中。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/fadf8faadb187a37dc26d733e2054837.appmsg_mw680water
不过在现场演示的诸多NVIDIA技术中，保密程度最高的还是当属DLSS 5，在一间独立的小屋中进行，不能录像和拍照。或许是因为之前DLSS 5首曝的时候带来了一些AI伦理和艺术风格方面的争议，这次NVIDIA只用了最稳妥的《NBA 2K27》作为官方演示。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/61a52f0bde39d36b03a7167f3a6e31b2.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/750309dfd5929ef41ac289ff78a97cb4.appmsg_mw680water
关闭DLSS 5（上图）和开启DLSS 5（下图）对比。点击大图可以看到，除了球员以外，就连体育游戏一向很难兼顾的观众席，质感也有了明显提升
为什么说稳妥？因为DLSS 5的3D 引导神经网络渲染实在是太适合追求写实的体育游戏了，可以说就是一张通往次世代的最速船票。当时我现场看完，感觉至少在写实画风的游戏里，DLSS 5应该能把口碑稳住了，之后就是看怎么优化模型和算法，慢慢应用到风格多样的场景中，让更多玩家逐渐接受。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/42002c6a3066acacd86b057d91d3d43e.appmsg_mw680water
追求拟真画面的赛车游戏显然也从DLSS 5受益匪浅
结果没想到的是，这几天的一场意外，把DLSS 5这项新技术的传播和认知路径，进行了一次充满戏剧性的加速。
突然之间，网上各种游戏“开启DLSS 5后牛逼疯了”的视频开始满天飞。我在B站上频频刷到几次相关内容后，发现DLSS话题已经冲到热搜第三了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/58f12b73f8cbea1158a630f7e1f28999.appmsg_mw680water
尽管这些都是民间用第三方插件所实现的未经官方优化的效果，但在各种超逼真视觉奇观的刺激下，大家都迫不及待等待DLSS 5的到来了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/0bfe44310547cd667c9d472dd78e2c26.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/ee2146262845112b729028d71a073506.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/6221fb11d0d1471779ca446771b1a61c.appmsg_mw680water
这场玩家狂欢，源于一个微不足道的DLL文件。
8月26日，有玩家在刚进入抢先体验的《NBA 2K27》PC 版目录中，发现了一个过去从未出现过的文件：nvngx_dlssnr.dll。
文件名里的 NR，指向的正是 Neural Rendering，也就是神经网络渲染。这个版本号为 310.8.0.0、体积约 158MB 的运行库，很快被认为是 DLSS 5 的早期组件。
几小时内，RenoDX 社区的开发者便借助 ReShade 和自己的注入框架，让这套实验性神经网络渲染在《控制》中跑了起来。最早的版本只能处理人物，随后玩家又找出了风格、强度、色调和结构等多组参数。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/50606b9bd0866815355eb17c56f9ce31.appmsg_mw680water

随后几天的发展几乎是按小时计算的。最初的方案还要依附一款原生支持 DLSS 的游戏，并且只能对角色区域生效；很快，插件增加了多次推理、自动遮罩以及皮肤、结构、色调等控制项。后来开发者做出了通用的“Feeder”，尝试从没有 DLSS 的游戏中自行估算运动信息和深度，把最终画面喂给神经网络。原本只面向 RTX 50 系显卡的运行库，也陆续被修改到 RTX 40、30，甚至 RTX 20 系显卡以及 Linux 的 Proton 环境中运行。
结果是，DLSS 5很快从《控制》里一项只能“给人物加料”的实验，变成了可以覆盖整幅画面的通用后处理层。玩家不仅能调节写实程度，还能让模型连续处理同一帧，把材质、皮肤和光影一遍遍推向更夸张的方向；也可以用较低强度，只加强接触阴影、毛发、织物和表面反光。它距离原生集成仍然很远，却已经足以让一批旧游戏呈现出近似“重新打光、重新做材质”的观感。
这场玩家狂欢的热潮传播极快。
从最初的《控制》，到《赛博朋克2077》《GTA 5》《巫师3》《最终幻想7：重生》《星空》《艾尔登法环》《剑星》《霍格沃茨之遗》《燕云十六声》……几天时间里，相关对比图和视频几乎淹没了海外 NVIDIA 社区，以至于 Reddit 的 r/nvidia 版主专门开设汇总帖，要求玩家不要继续用单独帖子刷屏。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14368/8b83be2a41a8a4facc64146f96683dd8.appmsg_mw680water
这几天到处都是这类测试视频
国内玩家也很快找到了更野的玩法。有人把它装进模拟器，让十几二十年前的主机游戏获得新的材质与光照观感；还有工具尝试从任意 DX11、DX12 游戏中提取深度和运动矢量，再把画面送入 DLSS 5。
虽然目前这些尝试的成功率不高，但至少证明，原始游戏的年代和图形 API 已经不再是绝对门槛。尤其让怀旧玩家们兴奋的是这项技术在模拟器里的应用，有可能会让无数老游戏焕然一新。比如下图是有人在PCSX2 中运行 PS2 版《侠盗猎魔》。原本低分辨率、低精度的角色和场景，被模型重新解释出更明显的皮肤纹理、衣物质感和阴影层次。
更出人意料的是，这场实验很快越过了游戏边界。有人把插件注入 OBS 的预览窗口，于是采集卡、摄像头、桌面和视频源合成后的最终画面，都可以在送出直播前经过 DLSS 5。还有开发者制作了独立的摄像头 Demo：程序实时估算人物遮罩、深度和运动矢量，再让神经网络重建皮肤、头发和衣物的材质，已经能在测试中维持 30 帧，初步跑通了“把游戏图形技术变成实时人像滤镜”的构想。

技术爱好者们很快注意到，DLSS 5 的核心3D 引导神经网络渲染并没有想象中那么依赖游戏引擎。有开发者搭建了最小化的 D3D12/NGX 环境，只输入一张 RGBA 图像，既不给场景图、物体 ID 和材质 ID，也不给原始深度与游戏逻辑，模型仍然能够完成变换。准确的运动、深度和遮罩主要决定稳定性与可控性，而不是决定它能否启动。也正因此，一个原本被定义为游戏渲染阶段的封闭模型，几天内就被玩家重新解释成了视频处理器、直播滤镜和 AI 工作流节点。
有人用DLSS 5直接增强了电影《最终幻想：圣子降临》中的CG动画
这当然不等于 DLSS 5 已经被破解成了真正的通用滤镜。原生集成能拿到准确的颜色、深度、运动矢量、材质遮罩和场景语义，而民间工具只能尽力猜测或拼凑这些输入。两者的区别，就像让一个摄影师拿到原始工程文件精修，与拿着最终截图强行修图。
但即便如此，玩家依然玩得不亦乐乎。
DLSS 5 刚公布时，舆论并没有这么乐观，但这次民间实验反而让不少玩家的态度发生了变化。
虽然这几天有一些“强行开启DLSS 5导致游戏角色老了20岁”的离谱效果——目前民间拿到的模型数据很有限，对于非拟真的风格化画面，适用性并不高。但大家对这些问题普遍也就一笑而过，而把目光投向真正能发挥这项技术潜力的案例上。
换句话说，在这场民间实验中，人们不再笼统地争论“AI 画面好不好”，而是在主动寻找 DLSS 5 最合适的服务对象。
现阶段的答案显然是比较垂直的。它更适合真人比例角色、电影化镜头、写实材质和自然光照；对于赛璐璐、低多边形、像素风以及依靠不真实的色彩和阴影建立辨识度的作品，开发者则应该降低强度，甚至完全关闭部分对象上的神经网络渲染。
好在官方版本从一开始就考虑了这个问题。
DLSS 5 并不是一个只能全开或全关的固定滤镜。开发者可以调节强度、锁定调色，并通过遮罩决定哪些材质和对象接受处理。水面可以完全交给神经网络，木材只适度增强，角色皮肤则保留更多原始细节。它的理想形态并不是让所有游戏都长成同一张“AI 脸”，而是把神经网络渲染变成一种可以由美术人员精细控制的生产工具。
在官方支持中，开发者可以选择不同的DLSS 5模型和效果等级
民间版本缺少的也正是这种针对每款游戏、每个场景乃至每种材质的系统调校。
所以现在网上流传的效果，无论好坏，都不应该被当作正式版的最终质量。它们更像是把一台尚未完成的发动机拆下来，装进各种型号的汽车，看看能不能点着。
让人振奋的是：很多车居然真的开起来了。
当然，“能跑”与“能玩”之间还有很长的距离。
NBA 2K27是正式支持DLSS 5的首款游戏，包括我们在内的部分媒体获得了提前测试资格。根据我自己使用NBA 2K27实装DLSS 5的性能表现来看，要想一步跨越世代，基本要以50%的性能为代价，依然要依赖多帧生成来把帧数拉上去。
由于DLSS 5的效果实在特殊，对性能影响又非常大，因此至少在这次的NBA 2K27中，DLSS 5并不是一个常规的“画质选项”，而是集成在驱动层面的物理开关。玩家可以在游戏中按F9来即时开关DLSS 5。这样可能尽可能一目了然地直观看到DLSS 5带来的画面差异，以及它是如何吞噬近一半显卡性能的。
关闭DLSS 5（上图）和开启DLSS 5（下图）

这时候又可以感觉到，NVIDIA这些年布局的一切，光线追踪、超分辨率、多帧生成……仿佛都是在为了在这一刻。在开发者手搓已难以继续推动画质极限的当下，用近乎“外挂”的形式，趟出一条新的路。特别是当你把超分辨率和多帧生成等相关选项都设置为自动时，开启DLSS 5，就能通过Steam的性能监控窗口看到一双无形的大手在动态调控一切——GPU占用率从50左右飙升到100%，原始帧数骤降，但又被多帧生成拉了回来，从而继续维持在画质和流畅度的微妙平衡——这，完全是一整套系统多年迭代的成果。
至于目前的民间DLSS 5插件，因为测试版本、注入方式和参数都在快速变化，没有多少横向比较价值。基本可以初步确定的是，新游戏想靠DLSS 5跨入次世代观感，性能开销并不便宜。但相对来说，老游戏想要借此重返青春，倒也不是难事。
从技术演进的角度看，这次民间大搞“土法炼钢”，却也有着深远的象征意义。
整个2018年的 DLSS 1，曾经因为《战地5》等游戏中模糊、拖影的早期效果被大量玩家嘲笑。到了 DLSS 4 和 4.5，一些场景中的性能模式已经可以呈现出比原生 TAA 更稳定的画面。过去玩家争论的是“AI 生成的帧算不算帧”；现在，人们却开始用未经优化的工具，主动把神经网络渲染塞进自己喜欢的游戏。

news.title: 在中国“查无此人”的星战XCOM，已经7万在线峰值了
news.summary: 贴脸MISS倒是很还原。 今年8月27日发售的《星球大战：零号连队》成绩不错：发售后的首个周末，Steam在线峰值冲到77,889人，并登顶Steam畅销榜——可见星战IP在欧美地区还是相当有号召力。 也能看到星战IP在

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/c1cbb8ee50b5ff1fdb2193932e7d3cfb.appmsg_mw680water
贴脸MISS倒是很还原。
今年8月27日发售的《星球大战：零号连队》成绩不错：发售后的首个周末，Steam在线峰值冲到77,889人，并登顶Steam畅销榜——可见星战IP在欧美地区还是相当有号召力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/3ab9925169b5a550ccb783beef751cbc.appmsg_mw680water
也能看到星战IP在中国的式微……
不过从游戏角度来看，包括我自己在内的不少人更关心的则是另一个问题：它能当XCOM代餐么？
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/0d817bff210723a8287fcf82919fd872.appmsg_mw680water
有这样的期待，也和制作团队的身份有关：Bit Reactor的骨干几乎都来自开发过XCOM的Firaxis，预告里又透着十足的XCOM味。考虑到 Jake Solomon 等 XCOM 主创已经离开 Firaxis，指望原班人马再做 XCOM 3已经不现实，大家自然把这份期待放到了这部“精神续作”上。
通关之后，我不得不再次感慨：XCOM 2依旧是同类游戏里难以逾越的高山。《零号连队》多少填补了苦等XCOM 3不来的空虚感，距离预想中的“XCOM代餐”却依旧有不少差距。
但换个角度看，在这30个小时里，除了偶尔因bug导致游戏卡死外，我大部分时间都玩得很开心。从这点来说，“当不成 XCOM 3”这句话，倒也不太影响《零号连队》本身的乐趣。
游戏的前30分钟，XCOM味其实还挺浓的。
局内战斗方面，《零号连队》继承的是 XCOM 玩法里最核心的“掩体博弈”。战场被掩体切割成一块块，玩家要指挥小队互相掩护、绕到敌人侧后出手；命中率和行动点（AP）构成的博弈逻辑也和 XCOM 一脉相承。很多经典打法依然成立：先用手雷拆掉掩体，再集火暴露的目标，或者抢占制高点拿命中加成。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/234b38184a8a92e9a0386c1d65fa141f.appmsg_mw680water
游戏一边保留永久死亡带来的压力，一边用新增的大招系统，鼓励玩家主动制造战术优势。每次命中敌人并造成伤害，就能积攒名为“优势点”的资源，用来释放不同职业的专属技能：有的是对单个目标的三连射，有的是朝多个敌人抛出飞镖，再在飞镖之间连起一片电网。
该作把角色的 AP 上限提到3点，每回合能做的事更多，战斗节奏也快了不少：先布好阵型打一轮攒资源，放大招清掉关键目标，剩下的敌人补刀收掉，顺便积累下一轮的资源。这种滚雪球的爽快场面在实战中并不少见。
针对这套玩法的一些痛点，游戏加了几处“兜底”设计：每回合小队能触发一次必中的协助攻击，顺便给参与的队员攒羁绊值；射失的攻击大概率会打坏目标掩体，方便队友补刀；移动时 UI 会实时显示落点能打到谁、命中率多少，危险地带会提前提示。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/6d30765bcbf61f3d21b2481e8699d060.gif_mw680
提起XCOM自然也少不了熟悉的马枪
看得出制作团队没想动 XCOM 的框架，只做了些针对性调整，打的是安全牌。
原因之一，是Bit Reactor从《漫威暗夜之子》身上吸取过教训。团队不少核心成员在Firaxis任职时都参与过《暗夜之子》：它往战斗里塞进一套卡牌构筑，设计上广受好评、也确实新鲜。但“卡牌”这个标签和XCOM缺少交集，还让不少人下意识以为那是款打牌游戏，把不少XCOM老玩家挡在门外，最终在商业上也没能成功。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/20e63990cdd82a11324700f7ae99efd0.appmsg_mw680water
游戏设计师Jake Solomon事后也承认，加入卡牌要素反而把受众推走了
但玩得越久，越能感觉到它成不了 XCOM 的完美代餐。
XCOM的战略运营是一大重点：“化身计划”“全球恐慌”这类倒计时机制让玩家始终在和时间赛跑，中途还要兼顾基地建设、科技研发和队员轮换。高难度下，这部分带来的决策压力甚至比战场还大。
《零号连队》则几乎不用为宏观运营操心，重心换成了让主角亲自上场：在第三人称追尾视角下自由走动，和路人搭话打听当地势力，或拿望远镜侦察敌情。这些内容在主线里占比不高，不怎么拖节奏，但“亲自上场”确实更有临场感。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/a72cc54259ce71e08ca97ecdc12ae09b.appmsg_mw680water
战斗结束后直接切入第三人称视角，敌人的残骸就倒在不远处
玩法分野的背后，是两作的身份不同。XCOM的玩家是地球抵御外星入侵的指挥官，视角天然要高，得统筹全局；到了《零号连队》，玩家只是个佣兵队长，带好自己这几个人就行。所以它的叙事更接近美式RPG，重心放在体验剧情和经营小队上。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/0e7a1b4ae0f4b86ee6e76a8ab1efac7e.appmsg_mw680water
“暗中观察.jpg”
队伍组成也像RPG：出身、性格各异的成员凑到一起，有配合也有摩擦。比如来自昂巴拉的狙击手卢科，一入队就和克隆人士兵特里克起了冲突，两人所在的部队当年在战场上血战过，如今难免仇人见面、分外眼红。
主角要当这股摩擦的粘合剂，找队友谈心，听他们的故事和想法。卢科会讲自己对克隆人成见的由来：他反感这种“人造士兵”，觉得他们千人一面，只是服从命令的人偶。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/da0089917be379d76a29606a26ac85d4.appmsg_mw680water
游戏中还有一些对话分支选择，RPG味更重了
游戏中的队友始终保持着鲜明的个性，绝地学徒总会跟主角讲讲哲学，而曼达洛赏金猎人则更专注于她的猎物。随着剧情的发展，他们也会展开心扉，聊一聊自己的过往，甚至邀请玩家协助他们完成专属的个人任务。
游戏的成长体系也和“拉队伍”息息相关，在战场上互相合作可以提高队员之间的羁绊值，提升羁绊等级又会带来随机数值加成。队伍越团结，战斗力也越强。
既然剧情绑在固定角色身上，机制也得跟着调：在XCOM里，老兵被一发暴击带走虽然肉痛，损失的单位依旧能补充回来；《零号连队》的队友个个连着剧情，经不起这么死。于是永久死亡被做得很宽容，倒地三次才算真死，除了教程关被剧情杀的那位，通关下来几乎遇不到角色真正陷入绝境的场面。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/ea089402d60c5401d4d1100d489e8e15.appmsg_mw680water
用随机生成的大众脸角色进行战斗依旧是个选项，只是在剧情中他们存在感比较稀薄
成长也是RPG的路子：8个基础职业，中期解锁双职业后能两两组合、互相补短。比如神射手定位是架枪远程，可长管步枪开一枪就要2 AP，用起来显得笨重；兼职枪手后，靠1AP的快速拔枪就能补上这块短板。
不过技能树大多只加数值、不改机制，在找出最适合自己的职业搭配后，战斗越来越像是在比数值和构筑。尤其是后期面对血量逐渐突破100点的敌人，留给战术的空间反而变小了。甚至有些场合，我干脆让角色站在开阔地上，把更多AP用于进攻，这在XCOM的底层逻辑里本该是自杀行为，但后期的成型构筑确实禁得起这么浪。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/89f1fdd6701e9a87327306bfdea0ee77.gif_mw680
特定构筑能将扎堆敌人一键清除
看到这里，《零号连队》的定位已经清楚了：它想用XCOM那套美式战棋逻辑，做一部星球大战RPG，并不打算当XCOM 3。
对冲着硬核战棋去的玩家来说，落差多少会有一些。平心而论，游戏的制作规格确实高：虚幻5引擎打造的画面精细而清爽，剧情过场大多是电影式的演出，光是开场那段从轨道一路拉到地面的过场，就已经能看出投入的方向。但这些投入大多落在叙事和演出上，真正分给战略、战术玩法的并不多。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14367/9c9ba673393e08cf150a06a500eed354.gif_mw680
开场就是大场面
在自由探索阶段，能看到背景里激烈的交火
作为一部星战衍生作，这种取舍也说得通。XCOM 的战斗逻辑既有战术、硬核的一面，也有门槛低、易于理解的优势：“躲掩体、绕后偷背身”的思路直观，甚至可以把射击游戏的经验拿过来用。它又能装进任何有枪的世界观，《战争机器》里五大三粗的壮汉、《少前2》里的美少女都成立。
科隆游戏展上《彩虹六号》也官宣要做类似玩法的战术游戏
从这个角度来看，制作组选择XCOM同款战斗系统来转化海外基数庞大的星战粉丝也合乎情理。在战斗外则选择偏向RPG讲故事的路子，能让没玩过战棋的人也有理由打开它。反过来，冲着XCOM战斗来的人，也可能借它第一次接触星战。
游戏中也不乏一些针对粉丝的情怀演出
想明白这一点，《零号连队》的目标就没什么难理解了。它不打算像XCOM那样通过随机地图和 MOD 撑起几百小时的寿命，也没设二周目，而是把资源基本都集中在一周目上，把一个星战故事讲得有始有终。
结语
回到标题那个问题：它当不成完美的XCOM代餐，但好玩吗？
就我这次通关的体验来说，想找XCOM 3的人会失望，想看一个完整故事、顺手玩到一套不差战棋RPG的人，可能觉得刚好对味。
说到底，《零号连队》想做的是一部能玩的星战剧。就这一点来说，它做得不错。

news.title: Onimusha 展示了 Capcom 连胜的原因
news.summary: Onimusha: Way of the Sword succeeds because it does what Capcom games like Resident Evil 7 and Monster Hunter:

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/onimusha-blogroll-1788508482292.jpg

There are very few publishers who can claim to have had quite as prosperous a decade as Capcom. The company’s 10 best-selling games all launched within the past 10 years, a chain of good fortune that began with 2017’s Resident Evil 7. Capcom’s reimagining of gaming’s most important survival horror series became something of a formula for its wider success, and that template can be seen in action once again with this year’s Onimusha: Way of the Sword .

Aside from a couple of remasters and spin-off projects, Onimusha has lain dormant for 20 years. The entire original four-part series was released during the PS2 era, and so there have been nearly three whole console generations of progress since the last entry, 2006’s Dawn of Dreams . That project introduced what was, until Way of the Sword, Onimusha’s most “modern” idea: a fully 3D camera. For its earlier entries, Onimusha used fixed camera perspectives and pre-rendered backdrops, much like the original Resident Evils.

There's a good reason for that: Onimusha basically was Resident Evil. Set predominantly within the grounds of a single castle, 2001’s Onimusha: Warlords is a game of solving puzzles, unlocking doors, and eating herbs to stay alive. Shinji Mikami, co-creator of Resident Evil, even advised on the project. The series shed more of that survival horror blood with each successive entry, but when it comes to a brand new Onimusha for the 2020s, it would not have been surprising to see Capcom return to those roots and essentially clone its Resident Evil 2 remake but fill it with samurai and demons. Afterall, much of Resident Evil 7’s success is thanks to revitalising the past, the Baker Estate being a Southern Gothic variant of the Spencer Mansion.

But Onimusha: Way of the Sword is not Resident Evil with samurai. If anything, it’s Capcom’s answer to Sony Santa Monica Studio’s modern God of War games. It features furious melee combat with an array of flashy abilities. You face monstrous bosses, some of which repeat multiple times. Treasures are hidden behind knotty environmental puzzles. Your protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi, squeezes through gaps, and is accompanied by a disembodied advisor who is much too talkative.

This is still Capcom’s formula in action, though, just a different side of it. Resident Evil 7 ’s success is as much about wider influences as it is refocusing on roots. To put Resident Evil back on track after the much-too-bombastic RE6, Capcom studied the horror landscape. It saw the success of projects like Frictional Games’ utterly terrifying Amnesia: The Dark Descent, and how the limited vision enforced by a first-person perspective could create an oppressive atmosphere – an approach that turned the simple corridors of Hideo Kojima’s PT into a looping nightmare. Combined with the labyrinthine level design the company had perfected back in the 1990s, it would make for the ideal series reboot. Resident Evil 7 was born. A similar approach can be seen in Capcom's other landmark game of the decade – by adopting the open world format so popular in the West, Monster Hunter: World transformed a niche concern into Capcom’s best-selling game by over 10 million copies.

In Way of the Sword, you can see how Capcom has studied the success of God of War and similar modern action-adventure games in order to find a new identity for Onimusha. Those learnings are not just echoed in level design and individual features, but also in tone: Way of the Sword is surprisingly funny. Like Nathan Drake, Musashi adventures through Kyoto armed with a thousand one-liners. His face, modelled on legendary actor and Kurosawa collaborator, Toshiro Mifune, is incredibly expressive, often for comedic effect.

The original games were campy, but more so because that was simply the way games were written at the time – like the original Resident Evil, there’s a lot of unintentional comedy in Warlords’ script. But, as with the modern era of Resident Evil, Capcom made a deliberate choice. With Resi, it pushed aside the camp and doubled down on the horror. The remakes are much grimier than their parent games, while RE7 has the kind of filthy fears that’ll give you tetanus, and RE8 contains the series’ most terrifying scares in House Beneviento. For Onimusha, Capcom has pushed the other way, turning the Power Rangers camp of the original games into a deliberate flavour. While many will understandably opt for the Japanese VO for a more “authentic” experience, I think the bizarre Britishness of Way of the Sword’s English dub is intentional – not just in making Musashi more amusing, but turning his Genma adversaries into the Kyoto equivalent of London-accented orcs (a “Looks like samurai’s back on the menu, boys!” would fit in perfectly). While Way of the Sword does have its fair share of darkness and terror to reflect the survival horror leanings of the original games, there’s plenty to laugh at here, and Capcom wants you to chuckle.

But Capcom also wants you to sweat, and that’s where Way of the Sword’s greatest achievement comes in. As fun as the original games are, Onimusha has never offered any significant depth in its swordplay. If it were to live up to its new subtitle, the latest entry absolutely needed a new approach. It took that approach from FromSoftware’s masterpiece, Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice , and it smartly did so without turning Onimusha into a soulslike.

There’s already some debate as to how Souls-y Way of the Sword is, and for the most part the answer is “not at all.” But when it comes to Onimusha’s bosses, the Sekiro similarity is undeniable. The parry is your greatest weapon, and matching the rhythmic patterns of your enemy’s blade is the primary way of opening up attack windows. Like Sekiro, this is a game of wearing down an enemy’s stamina before inflicting massive bursts of damage, and then resetting the deadly dance to do it all over again. A delicate balance of offence and defence is demanded, as giving your enemy space allows them to regain stamina, the very thing you need to erode away to inflict the most severe punishment. You can’t simply spam attacks to burn through the enemy’s healthbar, or chug consumables to allow a barrage of your flashiest damage dealers – you must fight using a very precise set of tools, picked in response to a very particular set of attack patterns. Alongside limited heals, multi-phase fights, and the combat’s frenetic flow, it’s hard to deny that Onimusha’s new approach to bosses isn’t following in FromSoftware’s shinobi footsteps.

But Capcom wouldn’t have enjoyed its decade of success if it just pilfered from popular games with little care for how those ideas were implemented. Again, Way of the Sword is not a soulslike, and you can see that in its wider design. Genre rules like bonfires, world resets, and loss of XP resources are absent. Regular enemies are, if anything, too easy. And there’s not a poison swamp in sight. While all this does contribute to the feeling of the bosses being substantial difficulty spikes along the campaign’s route, it also ensures that Onimusha is not a grueling experience in the way that FromSoftware’s games can be – even when you’re on your sixth attempt at a boss, there’s no infuriating run-back to contend with, and that goes a long way to ensuring you don’t lose your patience when faced with a particularly tricky roadblock.

news.title: “这种批评是有道理的”：科隆游戏展对其对开发商硬件盗窃行为的冷酷反应表示歉意
news.summary: Gamescom said it is "committed to jointly reviewing and further improving security," but doesn't mention any c

content.v: Last week, in the wake of a rash of developer hardware thefts at this year's Gamescom, the event's organizers provoked a wave of outcry by publishing a statement that many perceived as callously placing the blame on exhibitors who hadn't adequately insured their equipment.

Today, Gamescom released an additional statement on X, admitting that its initial response was inadequate and committing to improving the rigor of its security procedures with input from affected exhibitors.
pic.twitter.com/lOxBnmMplB September 4, 2026

"Over the past few days, we have received a great deal of criticism for the way we communicated about the theft of hardware belonging to several indie developers. That criticism is justified," Gamescom said. "Our first response did not strike the right tone, and it did not show the people affected the empathy they deserved. We are sorry."

After acknowledging the emotional, financial, and professional cost of the hardware thefts, Gamescom said it has "been moved by" and is "grateful for" the outpouring of support for affected exhibitors, which "says a great deal" about the industry and its consumers.

However, that generosity does not, it said, "relieve us, as the organizers, of our own responsibility to work together with our exhibitors and partners to create the best possible environment for everyone. We are therefore committed to jointly reviewing and further improving security."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bxMQfU2ndf2ULk8KCFK8Z3.jpg

In addition to its standard post-event assessment of exhibitor feedback, Gamescom said it's committing to both "a dedicated review of security for indie exhibitors" and to hosting a roundtable with indie booth organizers "so that we can develop concrete measures together." Gamescom also urged any additional exhibitors who suffered thefts during this year's show to report those incidents to both the event organizers and to police.

What the statement doesn't mention is any possibility of compensation for affected exhibitors. PC Gamer contacted Gamescom's organizers at Koelnmesse GmbH to ask how many incidents had been reported, whether any compensation has been investigated or offered to exhibitors whose equipment was stolen, and what forms of vetting and oversight Gamescom security staff are subject to. Gamescom PR offered no response beyond referring PC Gamer to its two published statements about the incidents.

"Our commitment has always been to keep making Gamescom better—together with the community, not just when things go well," Gamescom said in today's statement on X. "That is exactly what we will do here."

news.title: 在大量失败的直播服务游戏中，我很惊讶地看到有人试图制作 MOBA
news.summary: Project Zeta is trying to crack a near-impenetrable market.

content.v: Making a live service game these days feels like trying to shoot an arrow at a flea while blindfolded. Striking gold with a hot new shooter or other team-based multiplayer game with a quirky twist seems like an exercise in futility, but that isn't stopping developers and publishers from trying to be the next big thing.

Personally, if I was trying to enter an already-volatile market, I'd probably be steering well clear of MOBAs. They're finicky, have a high barrier to entry, and require a ridiculous amount of time commitment to ever be remotely good at them. Even then, dragging a League or Dota player away from their game to try another one is a big ask. Hell, I'm still shocked Deadlock has managed to do it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vmNsmi4pLWRiT5MdcMxHGW.jpg

So I don't know whether to applaud developer Nirvanana for giving it a go with Project Zeta, or grab the team by the shoulders and give them a good old shake for doing something I perceive to be utterly reckless.

Though, as Nirvanana will maintain, Project Zeta isn't quite a MOBA. As the developer tells me, it's actually a 4v4 multi-team tactical arena battle. Not battle royale, just battle. "We tried not to be tied down to those traditional things," Nirvanana tells me as I sit down to try Project Zeta at Gamescom, though admits the game did start out as a more traditional battle royale.

But from there, it's evolved into a sort of battle royale-MOBA-hero shooter hybrid, pitting four teams against each other as they fight across a sprawling map for victory. I'm shown flashy footage of Twitch streamers popping off after winning teamfights, proclaiming how good it feels to win in Project Zeta—emerging victorious from a teamfight refreshes cooldowns for the winners, as well as resurrecting any teammates who fell in the scuffle.

It seemed all well and good, but I couldn't help but wonder how it felt to be on the other side. Making a victory feel amazing for the winners usually means making the loss feel particularly bad on the other side of things. "In the last test, that was actually the biggest feedback we received," Nirvanana admits to me.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WDtuGr8buH4BZyF3xPT8HW.jpg

Recent tweaks have apparently made it so that there's "bigger risk" for the winning team. "The more you're ahead, the more you have to seek out other teams and wipe them out … there's a higher chance of you making mistakes, and that's a bigger risk for the winning team." It's something I'm still not entirely convinced of, but it does at least seem like Nirvanana is doing its best to iron out any kinks as it continues to drip-feed playtests to its core audience.

How that core audience will eventually translate into playercounts with the full release, however? Nirvanana knows it's a tough ask. "You have to have a clear message," the developer tells me. "And you have to take the players that agree with that message, and you have to build a community before launch with those players. And I think that's the only way to secure success once the game launches.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cCLqqwyFgecBVWmRcZsVHW.jpg

"And so, through these continuous player tests, we want to bring in those players that agree with Zeta's message to our team. These people will be the evangelists, basically, that promote the game for us. One thing I can say with confidence is that Zeta is a game that doesn't exist in a genre that doesn't exist, and it has a very clear message. And so we're going to continue to put up the message that this is what Zeta is. It's about team fights, dense team fights, and those who agree with that will be able to come into our community and we will continue to engage with them."

It all seems like a very hopecore way of looking at things, though Nirvanana does cap it all off by admitting: "Games like us failed a lot. The track record isn't good." Well, for Project Zeta's sake, I hope it can carve out a slice of success in an increasingly difficult landscape.
If you're interested in checking out Zeta for yourself, there's a playtest running right now until 12am on September 7. You can sign up on the Project Zeta website .

news.title: 1 vs. 100 Live 是一种令人难以置信的创意风险，我希望看到 Xb​​ox 回归
news.summary: I so vividly remember making the time to log on and play 1 vs. 100 in the evenings the game was available, and

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/03/1v100-1788455254889.jpg

This is an IGN opinion piece from Ryan McCaffrey, who worked at Official Xbox Magazine from 2002-2012 during the original Xbox and Xbox 360 era before joining IGN, where he remains “the Xbox guy.” In the run-up to Xbox’s 25th anniversary, he’ll be sharing his memories from the platform’s first quarter-century.

To this day, the Achievements on my Xbox gamercard that I'm most proud of are the 12 out of 12 I got in 1 vs. 100. They are, of course, impossible to attain now, and so I will always cherish them. But 1 vs. 100 was more than a licensed video game adaptation of a popular game show. For Xbox, it was an incredibly gutsy creative risk that actually worked, and I'd love to see the company get back to that kind of boldness again.

If you're not familiar with the video game version of 1 vs. 100, it was an Xbox 360 game played live with actual Xbox players at certain times of the week when the show would be "on the air." It was, quite literally, appointment gaming. The majority of players were in The Crowd, aka the audience. You'd get to play along trying to answer the quick-response trivia questions. Meanwhile, 100 randomly selected players would get to be in The Mob, who would compete for actual prizes -- free Xbox Live Arcade games and/or Microsoft Points (for those too young to remember, these were virtual currency used to buy games on the Xbox Live Marketplace or on Xbox Live Arcade). Finally, there was The One, another randomly selected player who, if they could beat The Mob in the trivia challenge, could win even bigger amounts of cash (again, in the form of Microsoft Points).

I so vividly remember making the time to log on and play in the evenings the game was available, and trying to answer those trivia questions as quickly as possible. You could get on Party Chat with your friends and root for each other to make it into The Mob -- or even The One. I never got to be The One, but I did make it into The Mob once. I fared well enough that I did win an honest-to-goodness prize: 80 Microsoft Points, which was the equivalent of $1. That's a dollar more than any other game I'd ever played had given me!

Sadly, 1 vs. 100 didn't last. It had a real-life host, a crew of game and infrastructure engineers that made the live events work, server costs on Xbox Live, and goodness knows what else. I understand why Microsoft killed it, but still don't like it. 1 vs. 100 represented the kind of creative risk-taking that Xbox just doesn't do anymore. I get the franchise-first focus the new regime is taking now -- and I won't lie, it'll be nice to have Fallout games more than once every 15 years, as one example -- but it sure would be cool to see Asha Sharma and Matt Booty take the creative swings that made Xbox beloved and successful in the Xbox 360 era in the first place.

The concept of a live interactive video game show had so much promise and potential. As 1 vs. 100 reigned for a brief time, I remember how we would openly daydreamed together in the Official Xbox Magazine office about what other game shows could be brought to life this way: The Price is Right, Press Your Luck, or even Jeopardy and/or Wheel of Fortune. None of it ever came to pass, of course, and none of it probably ever will. But 1 vs. 100 was real, it worked, it was glorious, and I miss it.
25 Years of Xbox
For more of my memories from across a quarter-century of writing about Xbox games, check out these other stories:

Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .

news.title: 在开发商告诉我《The Ascent 2》有大型特许经营计划后，我对《The Ascent 2》充满了希望
news.summary: The Ascent 2 is a game I’ve hoped developer Neon Giant would make ever since I finished the wonderful The Asce

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/the-ascent-1788530961668.png

The Ascent 2 is a game I’ve hoped developer Neon Giant would make ever since I finished the wonderful The Ascent back in 2021 — and after speaking to the studio at gamescom, I’m convinced it’s now in the works.

Neon Giant is currently hard at work on No Law, a first-person Cyberpunk-style game with immersive sim elements set to be published by parent company Krafton. But it has also confirmed plans to turn The Ascent, which has had over 12 million players, into a franchise.

“It's something we always wanted to do,” creative director and co-founder Arcade Berg told me. “Creatively, after we were done with the first The Ascent — that was a smashing success for us — creatively, we just wanted to go somewhere else. We weren't ready to do more The Ascent there and then. And team size and also investment wise, we weren't prepared for multiple projects.

“But one of the great things that we are now working with Krafton is that we now have backing and support that we can take creative risks. So together with them, we've actually built a franchise plan. We're moving The Ascent from a game to a franchise. And we'll be dropping more news as we figure things out, because it's a longer-term plan. But it's really exciting for us to now know that we have backing and support to do more. And what that is, I can't really go into details of.”

Neon Giant’s twin-stick action RPG impressed players for its punchy action, highly detailed environments, and beautiful cyberpunk aesthetic. In IGN’s The Ascent review , we said: “The Ascent’s satisfying gun-tastic action-RPG gameplay loop mixes with its beautiful cyberpunk aesthetic to create an overall enjoyable experience. Neither its story nor its characters are all that memorable, and its enemy encounters can stumble toward the end, but its gunplay and ultra-violence in a neon-soaked world combine to craft a co-op-friendly game you don’t see every day.”

In July, Krafton announced that an upcoming The Ascent update , due out in November 2026, will bring “a smoother more dependable experience for solo and co-op players, including improvements to co-op teleportation, the encounter system, save-game reliability and player-progression reliability.” The update comes out five years after The Ascent's release.

Krafton has teased that The Ascent will expand into new genres, which sparks speculation about what type of game the sequel will be. Will The Ascent stick to twin-stick action RPG, go first-person, or perhaps something else entirely?

The Ascent — and it looks like No Law will do the same — punched above its weight. Neon Giant was made up of just 12 staff before it doubled in size, to the heady heights of 24, to make No Law a reality. It remains an extremely small setup that’s able to get a huge amount of density and detail into its games. I can’t see Neon Giant ballooning in size as it works to make more The Ascent games, but perhaps it will take on a few more staff when the time is right.
In the shorter term, No Law is due out in 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S.
Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

news.title: 爆料称PS6成本持续飙升 索尼压不住 玩家遭殃
news.summary: 据gamingbible报道，PlayStation 6的售价再次遭到爆料，而且相比此前约1000美元的预估价格，最新消息显示其售价可能进一步上涨。

content.v: 据gamingbible报道，PlayStation 6的售价再次遭到爆料，而且相比此前约1000美元的预估价格，最新消息显示其售价可能进一步上涨。
几个月前，知名爆料人Kepler__L2曾率先透露，PS6售价可能达到1000美元。他最初表示，PS6的物料清单成本（BOM）约为760美元，也就是说，当时据称生产一台PS6所需的零部件及制造成本约为760美元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/04/small_202609042155599151.png
不过需要注意的是，BOM并不包含运输以及研发等成本，主要计算的是零部件和制造费用。
因此，如果再考虑其他额外成本，索尼最终将PS6定价在约1000美元并非没有可能，毕竟主机本身也需要实现盈利。
然而，Kepler__L2后来进一步透露，PS6的BOM成本已经上涨至约960美元。目前，全球零部件成本正处于高位，其中GPU和内存供应受到的影响尤其明显。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/04/small_202609042156057411.png
随着大量AI数据中心持续建设，市场对GPU和内存的需求大幅增加，并造成供应紧张。在这种情况下，RAM和GPU供应商纷纷提高价格，而游戏硬件以及其他面向消费者的科技产品，也可能将这些上涨的成本转嫁给消费者。
更令人担忧的是，这一趋势似乎还没有得到缓解。据VideoCardz报道，主板成本目前已经上涨约10%。ComicBook则声称，2020年生产一块PS5主板的成本约为40至50美元。
这意味着，按照Kepler__L2此前约960美元的BOM成本估算，PS6的物料成本很可能已经超过1000美元。

news.summary: Not one, but two Nintendo Directs are coming next week. Nintendo has confirmed that a Legend of Zelda Direct w

content.v: Not one, but two Nintendo Directs are coming next week. Nintendo has confirmed that a Legend of Zelda Direct will be held on September 8 at 7 AM PT / 10 AM ET, and it'll be followed by a Nintendo Direct on September 9 at the same times. The Legend of Zelda: 40th Anniversary Direct will run for 30 minutes, while the Nintendo Direct is scheduled to run for 45 minutes. For a closer look at the games shown off, you can also tune in to a Nintendo Treehouse livestream after the Nintendo Direct, which will run for roughly 110 minutes.

Rumors of a Nintendo Direct began picking up earlier this week after Ubisoft announced that a new look at Just Dance: Decades of Hits was on the way. It's worth noting that the publisher announced it for September 10, but given how often Just Dance games appear in Nintendo broadcasts, it was assumed this would be the date of a Nintendo Direct. With Nintendo hosting a September Nintendo Direct almost every year for the past decade--with 2024 being an exception--it looked like it was only a matter of time before the broadcast was officially announced.

As for what you can expect, Nintendo is keeping its lips zipped for now. Last year's September Direct was focused on several first-party games, smaller third-party titles, and the surprise reveal of a new Virtual Boy headset designed for Switch consoles, so we're guessing that it'll be more of the same for 2026. Following the release of the Switch 2 in 2025 and a steady stream of first-party games, 2026 has been slower by comparison, so here's hoping we get to see what new experiences Nintendo is working on. Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is out later this month, so we'll probably get a new trailer for the turn-based tactics game.

When it comes to The Legend of Zelda, it feels like Nintendo has barely acknowledged that this year marks the 40th anniversary of the beloved hero in green, but this could be a prime time to show what's on the horizon. The remake of Ocarina of Time was announced several months ago, and there's also the upcoming live-action movie --so a teaser trailer wouldn't be unwelcome. If we're lucky, we might even get confirmation that The Legend of Zelda: Wind Waker HD is finally coming to Switch consoles.

content.v: 曾因主演2011年《绿灯侠》而饱受调侃的瑞安·雷诺兹，近日在宣传新片时态度发生了180度大转弯。他在红毯上接受采访时公开表示：“我把整个职业生涯都归功于那部电影，我的一切都归功于它。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/04/small_202609042149133277.jpg
多年来，雷诺兹一直以自嘲方式调侃这部超级英雄电影，最著名的莫过于《死侍2》片尾彩蛋中，死侍穿越时空枪杀正在读《绿灯侠》剧本的雷诺兹本人。然而如今他却坦言：“制作那种大制作电影带来的核心教训是什么都换不来的，每一次经历都是一份不断给予的礼物。”
雷诺兹强调，他非常享受《绿灯侠》的拍摄过程，并从中学到了大量经验。此外，他也是在拍摄该片时结识了妻子布莱克·莱弗利——后者在片中饰演卡罗尔·费里斯。谈及是否愿意客串HBO新剧《绿灯侠》时，雷诺兹爽快回应：“我非常愿意，我很喜欢它。”
《绿灯侠》导演马丁·坎贝尔此前曾表达过对电影的遗憾，但也认为如果剧本由雷诺兹亲自操刀，“可能会很棒”。
如今雷诺兹这番改口表态，或许意味着他与这部曾被视为“黑历史”的作品终于达成了和解。

《绿灯侠》简介：几个世纪以来，有一群拥有强大力量的精英团队维护着浩瀚宇宙的和平。他们每人都有一只绿色的能量戒指，绿色的灯光就是他们的力量之源，他们被称为“绿灯军团”。但是，突然有一天，身处宇宙多处的绿灯侠不断传来受到袭击身亡的事件。原来，沉寂多年的邪恶魔王派瑞莱克斯苏醒，他要抢夺绿灯侠们的绿色能量源，因此展开了全宇宙追杀绿灯侠。这时在地球上，拥有非凡天赋却自命不凡的试飞员哈尔（瑞安·雷诺兹 Ryan Reynolds 饰）无意中获得了陨落地球的绿灯侠的绿色戒指，成为了守护地球的新的绿灯侠。而且其作为人类散发出的人性，也是其他绿灯侠们所不具备的独特气息。为了能打败派瑞莱克斯，保护地球拯救人类，哈尔需要克服恐惧，熟练运用自己的绿灯能量。魔王临近，哈尔能否打败魔王，成为最伟大的绿灯侠？
